title: Product Owner für Agentic-Twin-Plattform explore (m/w/d)
description:
Pfaffenhofen a. d. Ilm • Vollzeit • ab sofort

Wir sind EXP Software GmbH: Wir sind ein Team aus rund 25 Softwareentwickler*innen mit Herz, Humor und Leidenschaft für Technologie. Wir bauen explore, eine Agentic-Twin-Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei hilft, komplexe Prozesse durch autonome KI-Agenten abzubilden und zu automatisieren.Unser Produkt wächst und damit auch die Anforderungen an jemanden, der den Überblick behält: zwischen dem, was Kunden brauchen, was die Geschäftsführung vorhat, und dem, was das Entwicklungsteam realistisch umsetzen kann. Genau diese Brücke baust du. Wir suchen keinen Prozess-Verwalter, der Tickets schiebt. Wir suchen jemanden, der explore wirklich versteht, sich für das Produkt begeistert und mit Klarheit und Konsequenz dafür sorgt, dass die richtigen Dinge in der richtigen Reihenfolge gebaut werden.

Aufgaben

Produktvision & Roadmap

  • Du erstellst und verantwortest das Product Backlog für explore: Pflege, Priorisierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung in enger Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Kunden und Entwicklungsteam.
  • Du übersetzt Geschäftsziele und Kundenanforderungen in klare, umsetzbare User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien, und das präzise genug für das Team und verständlich genug für alle anderen.
  • Du setzt klare Prioritäten und begründest sie: Was bauen wir als nächstes – und warum?
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine mittelfristige Produkt-Roadmap und hältst sie am Leben.
  • Du durchdringst die explore-Plattform inhaltlich: Agentenlogik, Automatisierungskonzepte, Möglichkeiten und Grenzen und bringst Impulse aus dem KI-Markt direkt ins Produkt.

Team & Wissenstransfer

  • Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit Bestandskunden, verstehst ihre Arbeitsprozesse und erkennst, welche Anforderungen wirklich wichtig sind und welche nur laut.
  • Du übersetzt Kundenfeedback, Support-Erkenntnisse und Marktbeobachtungen in konkrete Produktentscheidungen.
  • Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eingehende Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass nichts verloren geht, alles bewertet wird und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar sind.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deiner eigenen Arbeit: zur Recherche, Dokumentation, Analyse, Priorisierung und Automatisierung.

Zusammenarbeit & Steuerung

  • Du arbeitest täglich eng mit unseren Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern zusammen: Sprint Planning, Refinements, Reviews; du bist dabei und bringst dich inhaltlich ein.
  • Du beantwortest Rückfragen des Teams schnell und verbindlich, nimmst Ergebnisse ab und stellst sicher, dass sie den definierten Akzeptanzkriterien entsprechen.
  • Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge gut genug, um sinnvolle Abwägungen zwischen Aufwand und Nutzen zu treffen.
  • Du planst Demos vor Kunden und Stakeholdern und führst diese direkt im Produkt auch selbst aus.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Tech-Umfeld und weißt, wie agile Produktentwicklung in der Praxis funktioniert.
  • Eine Zertifizierung als Product Owner ist wünschenswert, aber kein Muss.
  • Du hast ein solides Verständnis von Softwareentwicklung und KI-Konzepten. Ein Informatikstudium oder eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker ist wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend. Entscheidend ist, dass du mit dem Entwicklungsteam auf Augenhöhe kommunizieren kannst.
  • Du verstehst, wie LLMs, Agenten und Automatisierungssysteme funktionieren; nicht zwingend auf Code-Ebene, aber konzeptionell sicher genug, um Produktentscheidungen darauf zu gründen.
  • Du kannst gut zuhören, präzise zusammenfassen und Anforderungen so formulieren, dass sie das Team direkt umsetzen kann.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, priorisierst klar und verlierst auch bei vielen parallelen Themen nicht den Überblick.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf allen Ebenen: mit Kunden, Entwicklern und der Geschäftsführung gleichermaßen und verwendest jeweils die richtige Ansprache.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung; Englisch ist im technischen Kontext selbstverständlich.
  • Wir wünschen uns jemanden, der hauptsächlich bei uns vor Ort ist. Mindestens 3 von 5 Tagen in unserem Büro in Pfaffenhofen. Remote-Tage sind selbstverständlich möglich und Teil unserer Arbeitsweise.

Benefits

  • Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit 30 Tagen Urlaub.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeitgestaltung.
  • Ein kollegiales, wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Raum für eigene Ideen.
  • Budget für Weiterbildung und die Tools, die du brauchst.
  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wohin sich explore entwickelt - mit echtem Einfluss auf Produktvision und Roadmap.
  • Du arbeitest an einer Plattform am Puls der aktuellen KI-Entwicklung und hast damit Einfluss auf Architektur und Produktrichtung.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Schick uns:

  • Deinen Lebenslauf.
  • Optional: Nachweis deiner PO-Zertifizierung.
  • Optional: Ein kurzes Beispiel, wie du eine komplexe Kundenanforderung in konkrete User Stories übersetzt hast. Das interessiert uns mehr als ein klassisches Anschreiben.

Fragen? Wir melden uns schnell.

WÜNSCHENSWERT, ABER NICHT BEDINGUNG

description:

About us

AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

The role

As Frontend Engineer you own the web applications people use to run our instrument and read its results: an operator console that configures and runs scans with live camera and stage data, and a reconstruction front-end for setting up runs and inspecting images. Your users are the engineers in our lab, so feedback is immediate. You work closely with the Embedded, Software and Algorithm engineers who build the systems behind your interfaces.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain the frontends of our acquisition and reconstruction applications, from design to release.

  • Develop real-time views of camera images, stage positions and scan progress streamed from the instrument.

  • Design clear, safe operator workflows for configuring and running measurements.

  • Keep a shared design system and component library across our applications.

  • Extend the Python and C# backends where a feature needs it, together with the backend owners.

  • Take part in code review and bring good frontend practice to the team: typing, testing, CI.

Your profile

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • ~3–5 years of experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript.

  • Experience with real-time or data-heavy interfaces (WebSockets, streaming data, canvas or WebGL rendering).

  • Strong CSS and a feel for clean, usable interface design.

  • Working knowledge of Python or C# and REST APIs.

  • Experience with Git and collaborative code review.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you.

Bonus

  • Experience building software for scientific instruments, industrial machines or other hardware.

  • Experience with image or scientific data visualization.

  • Experience with FastAPI or ASP.NET Core, end-to-end testing (Playwright, Cypress), or working in a Scrum team.

  • Interest in optics, imaging or semiconductor metrology.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the user-facing software of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

  • A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product.

  • Work at the meeting point of software, optics and hardware, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven.

  • A competitive salary for the Dutch market.

title: Associate GEO and SEO Specialist
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Role context

This role sits on the Demand Generation team, where SEO and GEO (generative engine optimization) is a fast-growing source of pipeline. Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews which maintenance software to consider, and our job is to make sure MaintainX is in that answer and described well. Today the work is run by one person. You'll help make it a team of two.

The role

  • You will turn our SEO and GEO strategy into shipped work, so MaintainX shows up wherever buyers search.

  • Run content refreshes and gap pieces from brief to QA to publish, so priority pages recover and hold their rankings and AI citations.

  • Review backlink and offsite citation prospects to keep every link we earn high quality.

  • Support technical SEO and keyword research, flagging issues and opportunities before they cost us traffic.

  • Be the day-to-day contact for our web, design, content and product teams and outside vendors, turning their requests into clear next steps and following through until the work ships.

  • Design and run experiments with our Senior SEO/GEO Specialist to learn what moves visibility in LLMs, and document what you find.

Most of your partners don't own SEO, so part of the job is explaining why a change matters so they want to make it. Our Senior Specialist will train you on our tools and processes and mentor you. Within 6 to 12 months, you'll own execution on the team's core projects, handle ad hoc requests independently, and propose experiments of your own.

About you

  • 1 to 2 years in SEO, through a role or a strong internship

  • Hands-on keyword research and rank tracking in Semrush, Ahrefs or a similar tool

  • A clear view of how search is changing, including how LLMs surface and cite sources

  • Tests you've run or contributed to, and what you learned from them (side projects exploring GEO count)

  • Experience explaining technical ideas to non-technical teammates and getting them on board

  • The organization to juggle several projects and follow up until each is done

  • Comfort making decisions without a clear answer, because search rarely offers one

  • Nice to have

  • Screaming Frog or other technical audit tools

  • Exposure to GEO and AEO tools such as Profound or AirOps

  • B2B SaaS or demand generation experience

We offer

  • A product worth recommending. Operations teams in factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses already choose MaintainX, so you'll be earning visibility for something customers love.

  • An early seat. GEO is new and our team is small. You'll own real projects from week one and learn from the person who built the playbook.

  • Autodesk scale, same mission. As part of Autodesk, we have more resources and reach, pointed at the problem we were already solving.

  • Room to grow. Search is being rewritten right now, and the people who learn it early become the people the company asks.

Values and how we work

We reward output and promote quickly when people deliver. We test, measure and share what we learn, including what didn't work. You get autonomy, and we expect you to ask early when you're stuck.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

title: Enterprise Sales Engineer - UK
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:
You will assess a prospect’s technical requirements and apply extensive knowledge of Chainguard products to illustrate how a deal will satisfy the client’s unmet needs. You will cultivate relationships with decision-makers at all levels of an organization and negotiate the competing needs of multiple stakeholders within an organization. You will secure technical wins using methods such as demos, RFP/RFI responses, lead POVs, partner with engineering for requested features, and participate in conferences and industry events (when applicable).

What you'll do:

  • Partner with our Sales Team to help customers evaluate and prove the value of our solution
  • Focus on acquiring new customer “logos” in addition to growing existing customer base
  • Own all technical aspects of sales opportunities and assisting current customers understand the value of Chainguard
  • Day to day responsibilities include:
    • Listen to our customers and understand their challenges
    • Conduct product demonstrations and POVs/POCs
    • Actively participate in webinars, meetups, conferences and other marketing initiatives

What we're looking for:

  • Experience as a Sales Engineer / Pre-Sales Engineer
  • Experience with MEDDPICC and or Command of the Message sales frameworks
  • Experience selling into Enterprise (3+ years) and Mid Market prospects
  • Experience in the following areas:
    • Container technologies (Kubernetes, Serverless, Docker)
    • Cloud technology (AWS, Azure, Google, etc.)
    • Cloud security or containers security
    • App Security
  • Startup experience
  • Smart and passionate people that can persevere to success.
  • People acting as trusted advisors, able to build credibility with customers.
  • Strong team players committed to help and mentor their peers.

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

title: Account Executive TikTok Shop (m/w/d)
description:
Du willst keinen Job. Du willst ein Spielfeld.

Du weißt, was es für einen Abschluss braucht, denkst in Umsatz statt in Arbeitsstunden und wirst unruhig, wenn's zu langsam vorangeht?

Dann lies weiter.

Wir sind RealStudio, Social Performance Partner für Brands wie AG1, AirUp, TOOM Baumarkt & Smilodox. Im Agentur-Ranking von TikTok Shop sind wir aktuell auf Platz 4 in Deutschland.

Unser Ziel ist Platz 1, und dafür brauchen wir dich in unserem Account Management Team.

Aufgaben

Du bist das Gesicht für unsere TikTok Shop-Kunden und damit für unseren Backend-Umsatz verantwortlich. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Brands bei uns bleiben, mehr buchen und andere Brands an uns weiterempfehlen.

  • Kunden ownen, nicht nur betreuen: Du übernimmst die komplette Kommunikation, Strategie-Calls und Reviews. Du weißt vor dem Kunden, was er als Nächstes braucht.

  • Upsells, Cross-Sells, Verlängerungen: Du erkennst Potenziale, schnürst Angebote und bringst sie selbst zum Abschluss.

  • KPIs: NPS, Verlängerungsquote, Churn, Pipeline im CRM. Hier bist du verantwortlich und hast es selbst in der Hand.

  • Squad Lead: Du arbeitest eng mit 2–3 Creator Managern zusammen, die an dich berichten. Du gibst die Richtung vor und gehst mit gutem Beispiel voran.

  • Build the Machine: Du baust Account-Pläne, Review-Rhythmen und Prozesse auf. Wenn das Team wächst, kann daraus eine Lead Position werden.

Qualifikation

  • Sales im Blut: Du hast nachweislich verkauft und abgeschlossen. Wir bringen dir TikTok Shop bei, aber nicht, wie man verkauft.

  • Background: Aus E-Commerce, Agentur oder Selbstständigkeit, zum Beispiel TikTok Shop, Amazon, eBay, Account Management in einer Agentur oder ein eigenes E-Com-Business mit eigenem Vertrieb.

  • Brain & Speed: Du verstehst Dinge schnell, bist street smart und musst nicht alles dreimal erklärt bekommen.

  • People Skills: Kunden arbeiten gern mit dir, weil du ehrlich, schnell und angenehm bist. It's a people game.

  • Performance-Mindset: Du hast Bock zu arbeiten und Geld zu verdienen. Eine Deadline steht an und du klappst den Laptop zu? Dann passt es nicht.

  • Remote: Wenn du remote arbeiten willst, hast du schon mindestens 1 Jahr remote gearbeitet und weißt, wie man sich selbst organisiert.

Benefits

Quasi selbstständig, aber ohne den ganzen Stress
Viele von uns ticken wie Unternehmer. Bei RealStudio bekommst du das, was die Selbstständigkeit gut macht: Ownership, keine Hierarchien und ein Einkommen, das nach oben offen ist.

Was du dir dabei sparst: Buchhaltung, Rechnungen schreiben, Kunden akquirieren und die Unsicherheit, ob nächsten Monat genug reinkommt. Die Leads bringt unser Sales-Team, die Delivery macht das Backend. Du konzentrierst dich darauf, Kunden groß zu machen.

Was dich sonst noch erwartet:

  • Fixum plus Provision auf den Umsatz deiner Brands plus Boni für Verlängerungen, Upsells und Cross-Sells. Monatlich ausgezahlt, nach oben offen.

  • Vertrauen ab Tag 1: Du hast eine Idee? Dann let's go! Wir arbeiten ohne starre Vorgaben und Politik, direkt mit den Foundern.

  • Eine Lernkurve wie sonst kaum wo: TikTok Shop ist der am schnellsten wachsende Commerce-Kanal, und wir sind mittendrin. Wir hinterfragen Prozesse und Ergebnisse jede Woche.

  • Remote oder Berlin: Du entscheidest. Unser Office in der Eberswalder Straße hat 300 m², zwei Dachterrassen und Klimaanlage.

  • Ein Team, das sich wie Freunde anfühlt: ca. 30 Leute, die gern zusammenarbeiten und gemeinsam Gas geben.

  • Die Basics: unbefristeter Vertrag, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Sport-Benefits und betriebliche Altersvorsorge ab dem 2. Jahr.

Klingt genau nach dir? Dann bewirb dich jetzt.

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)


Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

About the Role

As Socketâs first Account Executive in Japan, youâll help build our business in a developing market while bringing software supply chain security to more organizations. Youâll own customer opportunities from initial outreach through close and help establish a repeatable local sales motion.

You'll partner closely with security, engineering, and executive stakeholders while helping shape our regional go-to-market strategy, sales process, and customer expansion efforts.

What You'll Do

  • Build the territory. Identify promising accounts, generate pipeline through outreach and relationships, and follow up on inbound and partner introductions.

  • Own the sales cycle. Lead discovery, develop account plans, align stakeholders, and guide opportunities through commercial negotiations and close.

  • Sell to technical and business audiences. Connect customersâ security and development challenges to Socketâs value, tailoring conversations to engineers, security leaders, and executives.

  • Partner on technical evaluations. Bring Sales Engineering into opportunities early and coordinate customer needs, evaluation milestones, and next steps.

  • Work with local partners. Collaborate with resellers, distributors, and other partners on opportunities and customer relationships alongside Socketâs channel team.

  • Build a repeatable motion. Maintain a clear pipeline and forecast, share what works, and help improve messaging and sales processes for Japan.

  • Bring the market back to Socket. Share customer and partner feedback with Sales, Product, and Marketing, and coordinate a thoughtful handoff to post-sales teams.

What You'll Bring

You bring:

  • A track record of building pipeline and closing B2B software deals against sales goals.

  • Experience selling in Japan and navigating customer relationships and buying processes there.

  • Ability to conduct customer conversations in Japanese and collaborate effectively with colleagues in English.

  • Experience managing the full sales cycle, including complex deals with multiple technical and business stakeholders.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience selling application security, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or software supply chain security.

  • Market competitive salary bands

  • Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

  • Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

  • Paid parental leave

  • Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites

At Socket, we

  1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

  2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

  3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

title: IT-Supporter:in für Non-Profits (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind das Rückgrat einiger Non-Profit-Organisationen in Berlin. Wir bauen verlässliche und sichere IT-Lösungen, damit sich Vereine, Stiftungen und NGOs auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren können: ihre Mission. Bei uns bist du keine anonyme Hotline – sondern ein fester, gern gesehener IT-Ansprechpartner, der mit Know-how wirklich etwas bewegt.

Unsere Kund:innen sind Organisationen wie das Deutsche Kinderhilfswerk, die Technologiestiftung Berlin oder die Weltbank Group – Menschen, die mit ihrer Arbeit etwas verändern. Und du sorgst dafür, dass ihre IT verlässlich funktioniert.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle im Tagesgeschäft – und du löst den Großteil selbst. Innerhalb unserer Standards handelst du eigenverantwortlich: Accounts, Gruppen, Berechtigungen, Software-Rollouts. Die Standards selbst entwickelst du gemeinsam mit der IT-Administration weiter – du bringst ein, was dir im Alltag auffällt, und erkennst, was sich automatisieren lässt. Wer bei dir landet, soll sich gut aufgehoben fühlen.

Was du bei uns machst

First & Second Level Support

  • Anfragen via Slack, Microsoft Teams, E-Mail

  • Probleme analysieren, Ursachen finden, Lösungen sauber umsetzen oder gezielt eskalieren

  • Schnelle Reaktionszeiten, freundlicher Ton, klare Sprache

  • Wiederkehrende Themen erkennen und Verbesserungen anstoßen

Accounts, Identitäten & Berechtigungen

  • Passwort- und MFA-Resets inklusive sauberer Identitätsprüfung – kein Reset ohne Verifikation

  • Benutzer, Gruppen und Verteilerlisten in Microsoft 365 und Google Workspace anlegen und pflegen

  • Sicherheitsgruppen und Berechtigungen zuweisen

  • Lizenzen zuweisen und im Blick behalten

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Geräte einrichten, ausliefern und wieder einsammeln

  • Accounts anlegen und sperren, Zugänge sauber entziehen

  • Welcome-Pakete und erste Einweisungen für neue Mitarbeitende unserer Kund:innen

  • Strukturierte Übergaben, damit nichts liegen bleibt

Endgeräte, Software & Rollouts (macOS & Windows)

  • Hardware-Probleme triagieren und nachhalten

  • Software für Windows und macOS paketieren und über Intune ausrollen

  • Updates und Patches ausrollen, Compliance im Blick behalten

  • Apple-Geräte über Apple Business Manager startklar machen

M365 & Google Workspace im Alltag

  • Mailbox- und Postfach-Probleme

  • SharePoint, OneDrive und Drive: Berechtigungen, Freigaben, Strukturen

  • Teams- und Meet-Setup für neue Nutzer:innen

User-Schulungen & Hilfe vor Ort

  • Kurze Schulungen zu MFA, Passwortmanager und Phishing

  • Punktuell vor Ort in Berlin: Hardware-Auslieferung, kleine Schulungen, einfache Netzwerk-Themen

  • Verständliche Erklärungen – auch für nicht-technische Menschen

Dokumentation & Knowledge Base

  • Lösungen sauber in Tickets festhalten

  • Kurze User-Guides erstellen („Wie aktiviere ich MFA?“, „Wie teile ich einen SharePoint-Ordner?“)

  • Wiederkehrende Themen identifizieren und Standards mitentwickeln

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du arbeitest überwiegend vor Ort: im Büro in Schöneberg und regelmäßig bei unseren Kund:innen in Berlin, dazu ein Tag Homeoffice pro Woche. Ein Remote-Job ist diese Stelle nicht.

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker:in Systemintegration oder mindestens zwei Jahre Praxis in IT-Support oder Administration

  • In mindestens einem dieser Themen hast du echte Praxis, nicht nur Schulungswissen: Apple im Unternehmen, Synology, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Netzwerk, IT-Security oder Open-Source-Infrastruktur wie Linux und Proxmox

  • In den anderen Themen bringst du solide Grundlagen mit

  • Verantwortungsvoller Umgang mit KI: Du nutzt KI-Tools gern und prüfst ihre Ergebnisse, bevor sie bei Kund:innen landen. Du führst kein Skript aus, das du nicht verstehst, und gibst Kundendaten nur in freigegebene Tools

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Geduld und freundlicher Umgang, auch bei wiederkehrenden Anfragen

  • Du erklärst Technik klar und verständlich

Nice to have

  • Führerschein Klasse B

  • Skripting (PowerShell oder Shell)

  • Netzwerk-Grundlagen, z. B. UniFi, VLANs, DNS/DHCP

  • Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen oder ITIL

  • Ein eigenes Homelab – erzähl uns davon

  • Interesse am Non-Profit- und NGO-Umfeld

  • Lust auf Weiterentwicklung in Richtung IT-Administration

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gehalt: 40.000 – 52.000 € brutto/Jahr (je nach Erfahrung)

  • Vollzeit, 40 Stunden pro Woche

  • Arbeit mit Sinn: du unterstützt Organisationen, die gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen

  • Kleines, wachsendes Team mit kurzen Wegen – kein Ticket-Fließband

  • KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag: bereitgestellt und erwünscht, mit klaren Regeln

  • Wachstumsperspektive: Wir investieren in bezahlte Fortbildungen und entwickeln dich bewusst weiter (Richtung Admin, Cloud oder Security)

  • Einladendes Büro (guter Kaffee!) in Berlin-Schöneberg und ein fester Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche

  • Regelmäßig gemeinsam raus – Teamreise in die Berge oder ans Meer

  • Weitere Benefits wie Gym-Membership oder Deutschlandticket besprechen wir gerne persönlich

So bewirbst du dich

Bitte bewirb dich über das Bewerbungsformular, nicht per E-Mail – so geht keine Bewerbung unter. Im Formular stellen wir dir ein paar kurze Fragen. Ein Anschreiben ist optional.

Nenn bitte nur Tools, mit denen du wirklich gearbeitet hast. Im ersten Gespräch, 30 Minuten per Videocall, gehen wir genau diese Themen mit dir durch, an einem echten Fall aus unserem Alltag und ohne Fangfragen. Eine ehrlich benannte Lücke ist uns lieber als eine lange Liste.

title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Microsoft 365 & Infrastruktur
description:

Sie möchten nicht nur Systeme administrieren, sondern eine IT-Landschaft aktiv weiterentwickeln? Sie schätzen die Vielfalt einer internen IT-Abteilung und fühlen sich in einer Windows- und Microsoft-365-Umgebung zu Hause? Dann bietet Ihnen die DOMUS AG eine spannende berufliche Perspektive.

Die DOMUS Steuerberatungs-AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft ist ein etabliertes Beratungsunternehmen mit rund 130 Mitarbeitenden und besonderer Expertise in der Immobilien- und Wohnungswirtschaft. Als Teil einer deutschlandweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe verbindet sie fachliche Kompetenz mit einem professionellen und zukunftsorientierten Arbeitsumfeld.

Zur Erweiterung des bestehenden IT-Teams am Standort Berlin sucht die DOMUS AG einen engagierten IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d), der Freude an vielseitigen Infrastrukturaufgaben hat und die Transformation der bestehenden IT-Systeme aktiv mitgestaltet.

Hier können Sie etwas bewegen

  • Sie administrieren und entwickeln die bestehende Microsoft-Windows-Infrastruktur einschließlich Windows-Domänen, Datei- und Druckdiensten weiter.

  • Sie betreuen die Microsoft-365-Umgebung sowie die eingesetzten Antispam- und Antimalware-Lösungen.

  • Sie stellen den zuverlässigen Betrieb der Netzwerkinfrastruktur mit Routern, Switches, Subnetzen und WLAN sicher.

  • Sie installieren, konfigurieren und betreuen Windows-Workstations, Laptops und weitere Endgeräte.

  • Sie kümmern sich um Storage-Systeme, SAN/NAS, Datensicherung und Backup-Lösungen.

  • Sie unterstützen die Mitarbeitenden bei technischen Fragestellungen – sowohl vor Ort als auch remote.

  • Sie betreuen Telefonanlagen, SIP-Trunks sowie Druck- und Multifunktionssysteme.

  • Sie übernehmen Aufgaben in der IT-Dokumentation, IT-Beschaffung und Inventarverwaltung und koordinieren externe IT-Dienstleister.

  • Sie wirken aktiv an der Modernisierung und Transformation der IT-Landschaft mit.

Der technologische Schwerpunkt liegt auf Windows-Systemen und Microsoft 365. Linux spielt im Arbeitsalltag eine untergeordnete Rolle.


Das bringen Sie mit

  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare IT-Qualifikation.

  • Praktische Berufserfahrung in der IT-Systemadministration und im technischen Anwendersupport.

  • Ein fundiertes Verständnis von Netzwerktechnologien wie TCP/IP, Routing, Switching und WLAN.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse sowie einen Führerschein und die Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen.

Ergänzende Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Storage, Backup, IT-Security, Telefonie oder IT-Inventarmanagement sind willkommen, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind Ihre fachliche Basis und Ihre Bereitschaft, sich in weitere Technologien einzuarbeiten.

Ein Arbeitsumfeld, das Ihnen mehr bietet

Die DOMUS AG bietet Ihnen nicht nur einen vielseitigen Arbeitsplatz, sondern auch die Möglichkeit, sich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln und eigene Ideen einzubringen.

  • Abwechslungsreiche IT-Aufgaben: Ein breites technologisches Umfeld statt der Beschränkung auf einzelne Systeme.

  • Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten: Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung der IT-Infrastruktur.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten nach individueller Absprache.

  • Individuelle Weiterbildung: Unterstützung bei Ihrer persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung.

  • Gesundheit und Mobilität: Gesundheitsangebote und JobRad.

  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Zugang zu Corporate Benefits.

  • Ausgezeichnetes Arbeitgeberumfeld: Auszeichnung als „Exzellenter Arbeitgeber 2026“.

Warum sich Ihr Wechsel zur DOMUS AG lohnt

Bei der DOMUS AG verbinden Sie die Vorteile eines etablierten Beratungsunternehmens mit den vielseitigen Herausforderungen einer sich weiterentwickelnden IT-Landschaft.

Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für Systeme, die für den Arbeitsalltag des gesamten Unternehmens von zentraler Bedeutung sind. Gleichzeitig erhalten Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre Erfahrungen einzubringen, neue Technologien kennenzulernen und gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden IT-Team die zukünftige Infrastruktur mitzugestalten.

Ob Sie bereits in einer internen IT-Abteilung tätig sind oder aus einem IT-Systemhaus in eine unternehmensinterne Position wechseln möchten – hier können Sie Ihre technischen Stärken vielseitig einsetzen und weiterentwickeln.

WE:MARQ. Wir machen CEOs aus dem Mittelstand auf LinkedIn sichtbar, von Industrie über IT bis zu Beratung. Nicht für Likes und nette Hundebilder, sondern dafür, dass ihr Markt sie als die erste Adresse in ihrem Thema sieht. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt, das nachweislich funktioniert: Mit vielen unserer Partner arbeiten wir seit 4+ Jahren zusammen. Jetzt wachsen wir weiter und erweitern dafür unser Content-Team. Genau da kommst du ins Spiel.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Brand-Strategie: Du entwickelst für jeden Kunden eine TOP-Positionierung, Zielgruppe und Themen, mit einem Ziel: Lösungsanbieter Nr. 1 bei den Wunschkunden zu werden

  • Content-Interviews: Du führst Interviews mit Geschäftsführern und holst raus, was sie von allen anderen in ihrem Markt unterscheidet

  • Content: Du machst daraus LinkedIn-Posts, bei denen Wunschkunden denken: „Bei dem Unternehmen MUSS ich kaufen.“

  • Tracking & Reporting: Du verlässt dich nicht aufs Gefühl, sondern optimierst Strategien und Action Steps auf Basis von KPIs

  • Projektkoordination: Du steuerst die Projekte intern mit unserem Team

  • Du hast bereits Personal Brands für Entscheider aufgebaut und kannst zeigen, welchen Impact ihr generiert habt

  • 100 % remote, Einstieg mit 20 Stunden pro Woche

title: Scientist II - Molecular Biology
description:
About IMU Biosciences

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

About The Role

 

Core Responsibilities

Day to day responsibilities

  • Perform isolation and cryopreservation of cells from human blood samples

  • Perform single-cell RNA sequencing assays, ensure accurate sample identification, labelling, tracking and traceability throughout the sample processing workflow

  • Assess sample quality and suitability for downstream applications, escalating samples that do not meet predefined acceptance criteria

  • Ensure samples are processed, stored, and handled within specified timeframes and conditions to maintain sample integrity

  • Maintain accurate sample inventories and update relevant laboratory information management systems (LIMS) or sample tracking records

  • Monitor reagent and consumable stock levels, anticipate upcoming requirements, and communicate replenishment needs to the relevant team members

  • Ensure laboratory data and assay results are accurately recorded, reviewed, and stored in accordance with established procedures

  • Identify, document and escalate sample discrepancies, labelling errors, or deviations from established sample handling procedures

  • Perform investigation of unexpected assay results and contribute to identifying potential root causes and corrective actions

  • Maintain IMU lab quality control measures

  • Perform and assess routine equipment quality control checks

  • Monitor equipment performance and promptly escalate abnormal readings, equipment failures, or maintenance requirements

  • Involved with analysing, reporting and storing assay results

  • Establish priorities when involved in multiple projects and deliver on target

  • Maintain consistent and regular progress reporting to senior staff members and have effective lines of communication with all colleagues by being proactive with providing updates regarding progress and also voicing ideas, inputs and feedbacks

  • Communicate effectively across cross-functional teams

Supporting responsibilities

  • Perform assay optimisation and troubleshooting experiments

  • Participate in method verification, validation, or performance evaluation activities, as appropriate to the laboratory's quality framework

  • Provide technical and organisational support to the team and ensure that reagents are prepared, stored and used in an appropriate manner

  • Help with general laboratory maintenance including aliquoting, stock checking, receiving and storing of deliveries, day-to-day maintenance and cleaning of instruments and equipment

  • Coordinate sample shipment and receipt from our clients and partners

  • Contribute to highly collaborative research projects, working closely with colleagues

Continuous improvement and innovation of our practices

  • Identify and propose opportunities to improve laboratory workflows, sample processing efficiency, assay reproducibility, and resource utilisation

  • Support the development and implementation of laboratory automation workflows to improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability

  • Support the evaluation and implementation of new laboratory methods, reagents, equipment, and technologies

The above list of responsibilities may not be exhaustive, and the post holder will be required to undertake such tasks and responsibilities as may reasonably be expected within the scope, purpose and grading of the post.

 

Team and Ways of Working

Lab team

  • Office based, 5 days a week

  • Integrate in the molecular biology team

  • Work closely with flow cytometry part sub team

 
 

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

Qualification Requirements

  • A minimum of BSc/MSc in biological science degree with relevant work experience

 

Technical Must-Haves (Essential Skills)

  • Experience in molecular biology techniques including nucleic acid isolation, PCR, and next generation sequencing

  • Proven hands-on experience with single-cell transcriptomics assays (RNAseq essential), using platforms such as 10x, Parse, Rhapsody, or similar.

  • Familiar with working with blood and tissue samples

Nice-to-Haves (Desirable Skills)

  • Experience designing experiments

  • Experience with automated systems

  • Experience using LIMS and ELN

  • Experience working with human biological samples and familiarity with Human Tissue Act (2004)

  • Knowledge of ISO 15189:2022 and ISO 13485

  • Background or interest in immunology, with a preference for candidates who have worked within drug discovery / development.

  • Experience working in biotech or pharma space

 

Key Competencies

  • Able to work flexible hours when necessary to accommodate sample delivery schedules and R&D experiments

  • Troubleshooting skills and ability to independently drive experiments to completion

  • Meticulous attention to detail and a strong focus on accuracy

  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks to meet deadlines under pressure

  • Proactive/autonomous

  • Good interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Excellent teamwork, communication, and self-motivation in a fast-paced biotech environment

  • Eager and open to learning new skills at the cutting edge of immunology

Why Join Us?

● Competitive salary and company bonus scheme

● Pension, health insurance, life assurance, and income protection

● Fast-paced, collaborative startup culture

● Strong opportunities for career development and progression

 
 
 

Compensation: £47K – £54K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • Up to 15% bonus payable per annum

This is a role that will require travel for on-sites and events (30%), as well as a strategic mindset. Here’s What You Will Need to Know/Have:

  • Additional languages desirable.

  • Bachelor's degree and/or minimum of 2-3 years of proven sales experience.

  • Ability to conduct comprehensive needs analysis and craft compelling proposals that effectively communicate the value of our offering and align with the specific needs of the client.

  • Experience working in education or with a pedagogical background preferred.

  • Experience selling enterprise-level software, SaaS sales, and services.

  • Ability to do detailed needs analysis, proposal development, and tender completion.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

title: Product Engineer
location: PARIS OFFICE or REMOTE FROM FRANCE
description:
Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

🎯 The Role

We are looking for a Product Engineer with a strong product mindset to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of our AI-powered platform.

At Inato, being a Product Engineer means more than building features. It means understanding the problems we solve, the needs of our users, and the business challenges behind our decisions.

You will report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with a multidisciplinary team composed of a Product Lead, AI Engineers, and other Product Engineers.

You will take ownership of features throughout their lifecycle, from understanding the problem and challenging assumptions to designing, implementing, and evaluating solutions.

We believe that great products are built through a combination of technical excellence, product thinking, curiosity, and collaboration.

How is this opportunity different?

  • Meaningful impact: Contribute to making clinical trials more accessible and inclusive, with a tangible impact on patients' lives.

  • Product-driven culture: Work on an established SaaS platform alongside a product team that prioritizes business and user impact over the number of features delivered.

  • Intellectual challenges: Solve complex product, business, and engineering problems in an industry where AI plays an increasingly central role.

  • Engineering excellence: Join a team of 15 engineers with a strong culture of technical quality, modern technologies, and continuous improvement.

  • Continuous growth: Develop your technical and product expertise through ownership, learning, initiative, and constructive feedback.

  • Collaborative culture: Work alongside passionate colleagues who value knowledge sharing, mutual support, diverse perspectives, and collective success.

Typical projects you could be working on

  • Integrating Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems to help research sites assess patients against clinical trial eligibility criteria.

  • Building a centralized experience for research site networks, allowing them to apply to trials and assess patients across multiple sites.

  • Collaborating with AI Engineers to integrate AI-powered capabilities into reliable, intuitive, and valuable product experiences.

🚀 Responsibilities

  • Build features from beginning to end: discovery, design, implementation, deployment, and support.

  • Understand user needs and business objectives to challenge assumptions and contribute to product decisions.

  • Balance technical complexity, product value, and long-term maintainability.

  • Leverage AI tools to improve your engineering workflows while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and reliability.

  • Continuously improve our engineering practices, processes, and tools.

  • Learn from your teammates and share your knowledge internally and externally.

🔎 What We Are Looking For

Product & Business Mindset

  • You are genuinely interested in understanding why you are building something, not just how to build it.

  • You take a step back, ask relevant questions, and consider the broader business and user impact of your work.

  • You enjoy collaborating with Product Managers, challenging ideas constructively, and finding pragmatic solutions to complex problems.

Technical Foundations

  • You have 2+ years of professional experience building and maintaining web products within an engineering team, with concrete achievements you can talk about.

  • You have solid software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern web technologies.

  • Ideally, you have a full-stack background with a stronger interest in back-end engineering and software architecture.

  • If your background is primarily front-end, we also welcome applications from engineers who have started exploring back-end development or are genuinely motivated to deepen their expertise in this area.

  • You actively explore and use AI-powered development tools, with a critical understanding of their capabilities and limitations.

Growth & Mindset

  • You are intellectually curious, analytical, and able to quickly grasp new concepts.

  • You actively seek opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and expand your responsibilities.

  • Your career reflects a willingness to progress, explore new areas, and continuously improve your skills.

  • You value constructive feedback, collaboration, and collective success.

Professional Experience

  • You have experience working on a SaaS product, ideally within a growing startup or scaleup, where you have experienced evolving product needs, technical challenges, and organizational growth.

  • You can communicate clearly in both written and spoken English and French.

💻 Our Technical Environment

Explore our current technology stack and the tools we use to build and scale our product on StackShare.

We don't expect you to already master every technology in our stack. We value strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn.

⭐ Bonus

  • Experience with functional programming, particularly in TypeScript.

  • Experience building or integrating AI-powered features into production applications.

  • Previous experience in Healthcare, HealthTech, MedTech, or clinical research.

  • Experience applying software craftsmanship practices to maintain and improve a shared codebase.

  • Experience contributing to the evolution or scaling of a SaaS product.

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if your background does not match every aspect of the role. We value your potential, learning ability, and progression alongside your previous experience.

title: Performance Marketer, Acquisition
description:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.

We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

About the Team

Our growth starts with reaching the right sellers and earning their trust. You'll join Growth & Marketing alongside Creative, CRM and Brand, and work in an acquisition squad with teammates from Product, Tech and Operations. A performance marketing agency and freelancers handle part of the day-to-day execution. You'll report to our Growth & Marketing Lead.

The Role

As our Performance Marketer, Acquisition, you'll own paid acquisition and manage more than €15M in annual spend across Meta, Google, TikTok, ChatGPT and new channels. Your job is to turn that spend into seller leads and booked sales meetings.

Our goal is to double seller leads year over year and cut the cost per booked sales meeting by 10%. You'll need to maintain lead quality in a crowded market: Meta and TikTok are starting to compete for the same audiences, and so are Google and ChatGPT.

You'll also help us use AI to manage campaigns, produce ads and analyze performance, so the team can manage more spend and run more tests with the same headcount.

What You'll Be Able to Do in a Year

Ad platforms report clicks and leads. At Zefir, you'll follow those leads through to booked meetings with Sales and use what you learn to decide where to spend.

  • Allocate €15M+ a year by cost per booked meeting. Compare costs across segments and recognise when fewer leads signal better performance.

  • Measure what your campaigns actually add. Design and interpret geo-lift or holdout tests to find out how many extra meetings a campaign generated, and use the results to move budget.

  • Run acquisition with AI. Build your own agents and automations for campaign management, ad production and performance analysis, then measure their impact.

  • Use campaign results to improve creative. Brief and challenge our agency and freelancers, then work with our Content Strategist to turn what you learn into the next round of tests.

What You'll Do

Set the paid acquisition strategy

  • Set quarterly targets with our Growth & Marketing Lead based on how sellers behave, how the market is changing and what competitors are doing.

  • Decide how to split spend across channels and campaigns to hit those targets and keep generating leads at a sustainable cost beyond the quarter.

  • Find and launch new paid channels and lead-generation partnerships.

Own daily performance and the €15M+ budget

  • Optimise campaigns daily with Sales, Brand and Product. When a campaign underperforms, reallocate spend that day.

  • Lead the weekly acquisition review: explain where we missed the plan, what drove the gap and what you'll do to close it.

  • Maximise return on the budget. Use the cost per booked sales meeting in each segment to decide where to put the next euro.

  • Work directly across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, ChatGPT and new platforms, and know the tracking stack end to end, from Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking to attribution.

Measure what drives growth

  • Work with Sales, Product and Data to understand which sellers book a meeting and why, and use those findings to decide what to test and what to change.

  • Agree with Data on what counts as a booked meeting and how to attribute it.

  • Run incrementality tests, including geo-lift studies, to measure how many additional bookings campaigns generate, and compare the results with what the platforms report.

  • Keep testing new channels and campaign ideas, including new creative angles with our Content Strategist.

Work with Creative, our agency and freelancers

  • Share ownership of paid channels with our Content Strategist: they own the creative angles and assets; you own distribution, budget allocation and performance analysis.

  • Lead the work of our performance agency and freelancers. Brief them, challenge their results and decide which work to bring in-house as we grow.

Who You Are

People who do well at Zefir take initiative when the path is unclear and stay curious about the people they serve. They judge their work by its impact on revenue and put the team's results first.

You have 5+ years in performance marketing, in-house or at an agency. You've managed at least €1M a year across Meta and Google and worked directly with both platforms' account teams.

  • Good judgement under pressure: you read the data, make decisions quickly and know when to give a campaign more time.

  • Hands-on platform experience: you've run campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads, and you know Google Tag Manager, server-side tracking and attribution. Experience with ChatGPT Ads is a plus.

  • Commercial instinct: you want to understand what makes a seller click, book a meeting and ultimately sell. You know when fewer leads can be a good sign.

  • Strong collaboration: you work closely with creative teammates and hold agencies and freelancers to a high standard.

  • Curiosity about AI: you've used AI in your work or are eager to try it.

  • Languages: fluency in English and French.

Hiring Process

  1. 30-minute call with our Talent Lead

  2. 45-minute deep-dive with our Growth & Marketing Lead

  3. 60-minute live case with our Growth & Marketing Lead

  4. 45-minute interview with our co-founder

  5. References

Benefits

The following is for permanent employees only. For other contracts (interns, apprentices, fixed-term...), please check with your recruiter.

  • Competitive salary: You can run your own simulation with our salary calculator.

  • BSPCE (Stock Options): Available for everyone, with monthly vesting after year one, over a 4-year period.

  • Healthcare plan: Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children.

  • Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement): With flexible remote work options.

  • Swile meal card: €11 per worked day.

  • Swile mobility card: €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…).

  • Team events: Monthly events to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company.

Our Operating Principles

🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them.

🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes.

🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition.

Application & Process

We welcome applications from anyone, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, or experience. Our team values authenticity and diverse perspectives.

For all roles, our interview process emphasizes hands-on exercises, case studies, or discussions about specific examples of your previous work. We ensure objectives and expectations are clearly communicated at every step.

Compensation: €67K – €75K • Offers Equity

title: Pre-Sales / Sales Engineer
location: Paris, France; Marseille, France; Bordeaux, France; Nantes, France; Strasbourg, France; Lyon, France
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️

Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers.

Here are the main missions of the team you will join:

  • Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools;

  • Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best;

  • Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities;

  • Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts;

  • Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products;

  • Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap;

  • Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings;

  • Eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings leveraging your unique knowledge of the customer’s requirements and specificities.

You will actively participate in developing this growing function within Alan and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most successful of all!

Given the growing need for onsite customer engagement, you are ideally located in Paris or the Île-de-France region (or within a 2-hour door to door distance with the flexibility to travel to Paris on short notice for customer meetings).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-E level range.

⭐️ You will be a great fit if ⭐️

  • You have 6+ years of experience working in a SaaS environment, including at least 3 in a Pre-Sales / Sales Engineering / Solution Consultant role.

  • You have a talent for quickly getting to the root cause of customers concern through active listening and requirements elicitation;

  • You are assertive and know how to handle objections in a complex environment;

  • You master the art of pitching a product with transparency and without overselling its capabilities ;

  • You have the ability to break down complex issues and identify product gaps to define the best product solutions;

  • You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management;

  • You excel at prioritizing tasks while living up to commitments;

  • You love teamwork and are always eager to learn and grow;

  • You are fluent in both French and English;

It would be even better if you have:

  • Experience with end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s;

  • Experience in the French Public Sector;

  • Experience in HRIS ecosystems and Payroll solutions;

  • Experience in Insurance or Health platforms.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

title: Account Executive (F/H)
description:
Chez Younited, nous pensons que les services financiers devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique.

C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de clients nous font confiance et près de 500 collaborateurs contribuent à notre développement dans 4 pays européens.

Ce que nous construisons

    • Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients.
    • Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires.
    • Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.
    • Everyday financial services : Avec helios by Younited, nous proposons des solutions pour aider chacun à mieux gérer ses finances, tout en construisant notre future offre bancaire du quotidien.
Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident

    • Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence.
    • Act as an entrepreneur : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec.
    • Innovate or die : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître.
    • Faster is better : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat.
    • No limit : viser la lune tout en restant humble.
Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe.

Contexte 📄

En tant qu’Account Executive Growth (Small & Middle Business) chez Younited, directement rattaché.e au Lead Sales Growth, tu contribues directement à la forte croissance de l’activité BtoB en développant ton portefeuille clients.
 
Pour acquérir de nouveaux clients (marchands, établissements financiers, etc.) et contribuer à l’augmentation du chiffre d’affaires de tes partenaires, tu fais preuve d'une compréhension fine de leur secteur et de leurs enjeux.

Missions 🚀

1. Pilotage du cycle de vente
  • Gérer l’intégralité du cycle de vente : prospection, qualification, démos, négociation et closing
  • Organiser et suivre toutes les activités commerciales via le CRM
  • Atteindre les objectifs individuels et collectifs de new business

2. Développement commercial & relation client
  • Identifier et cibler les prospects pour développer la base clients
  • Comprendre les processus décisionnels et engager les C-level
  • Développer une relation durable afin de fidéliser et accroître la valeur client

3. Performance & amélioration continue
  • Contribuer à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie commerciale (plans de chasse, pipeline, closing)
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Produit pour améliorer les offres
  • Participer à l’optimisation des processus internes

À propos de toi 👇

  • Formation Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, école de commerce ou équivalent)
  • Minimum 3 ans d’expérience en CDI en vente B2B avec idéalement une première expérience en Fintech
  • Maîtrise complète du cycle de vente, de la prospection à la signature
  • Esprit analytique, autonomie, curiosité et proactivité
  • Niveau d'anglais professionnel

Processus de recrutement 📅

  • Premier entretien en visio avec Arthur, Lead TAM, pour discuter autour du poste et de tes motivations (30 min)
  • Deuxième entretien en visio avec Hugo, Lead Sales Growth, pour approfondir les missions du poste (1H)

  • Dernier entretien en visio avec Pauline, Head of Sales & Marketing, pour valider l’alignement global sur le poste et Younited (45 min)

🎁 Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ?

  • Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)

  • Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome)

  • Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited

title: 3D Game Artist - Core - Puzzle Unit
description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

 

Team

You will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

 

In this role, you'll work across our puzzle game portfolio, contributing your artistic skills to titles that have already demonstrated strong core mechanics and real player engagement. Puzzle games demand a precise and thoughtful visual language, from clear iconography and satisfying feedback animations to cohesive UI and world aesthetics, and your work will be central to delivering that.

 

You'll have the opportunity to contribute directly to the growth and visual refinement of our puzzle titles, leveraging their existing traction to build truly exceptional player experiences. This is a unique chance to join a project pipeline with established momentum, while still having a significant impact on the creative direction within a dedicated and agile studio environment.

 

Role

  • Support the Lead Artist in the ideation and execution of the game’s vision.

  • Design and implement a high-quality, scalable UI from concept to final integration in Unity.

  • Create and maintain a comprehensive UI Style Bible and reusable component libraries.

  • Create high-quality 3D/2D assets (characters, assets, props and environment art) and ensure optimal performance across mobile devices.

  • Setup, integrate, and animate UI scenes in Unity.

  • Work with Game Designers to ensure UI supports gameplay and accessibility goals.

  • Iterate quickly based on team feedback and live user data.

  • Propose creative ideas to boost player engagement and improve the user experience.

 

Profile

  • Strong Unity skills, with the ability to implement and optimise directly in engine.

  • Excellent 3D /2D design skills, with a keen eye for visual hierarchy, composition, and readability.

  • Experience with A/B testing or working with LiveOps features.

  • A keen eye for emerging mobile game trends with the ability to creatively deconstruct and learn from success cases.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional remote teams.

  • AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

  • Fluent in English.

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Premium healthcare (SideCare) for you and your family 100% borne by Voodoo

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Child daycare facilities (Les Petits Chaperons rouges)

description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to win and grow Enterprise customers by becoming the trusted partner of technical teams and their leaders.

As an Enterprise Account Executive covering Benelux (Belgium and the Netherlands), you will own a territory of larger organisations and drive complex deals from first conversation to signature:

GENERATE NEW-LOGO PIPELINE

  • Build and execute account plans for named Enterprise accounts with 1,001 to 5,000 employees.

  • Run outbound campaigns that open doors with CTOs, engineering leaders and platform teams.

  • Turn community adoption and inbound signals into structured enterprise opportunities.

LEAD COMPLEX, MULTI-STAKEHOLDER DEALS

  • Run deep discovery, quantify business impact and build a business case with your champions.

  • Map decision makers across engineering, IT, security and procurement and keep every thread alive.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical evaluations and proofs of concept.

CLOSE AND EXPAND

  • Own the sales cycle through security, legal and procurement reviews, typically over two to four months.

  • Negotiate with confidence and keep clear commercial control of next steps.

  • Hand over to Customer Success and plan expansion across teams and use cases.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏢 Enterprise SaaS sales: You have sold B2B SaaS into organisations of roughly 1,001 to 5,000 employees and can explain customer size, deal complexity and cycle length.

  • 🧑‍💻 Technical buyers: You have sold to developers, engineers, CTOs, CIOs and DevOps or platform teams, and you explain complex products without leaning on a Solutions Engineer.

  • 🧩 Complex deals: You have run multi-stakeholder cycles of two to four months and closed meaningful deals in organisations of 1,001 to 5,000 employees.

  • 🎯 New-logo hunter: You generate your own pipeline through outbound and win new customers rather than living off expansion or inbound.

  • 📈 Track record: You have consistently hit or exceeded quota over the past two to three years.

  • 🧭 Structured selling: You use a structured methodology (MEDDPICC or similar is a plus) and navigate technical evaluations, procurement, legal and security reviews.

  • 📍 Location: You are based in Belgium or the Netherlands, and you already have the right to work there.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical product background: You have sold developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data, AI or automation platforms.

  • 🚀 Startup or open-source exposure: You have worked at an open-source, product-led or Series A to C company.

  • 🤝 Technical network: You already know engineering and IT leaders in your territory.

Why join us?

You will win Enterprise customers with a product technical teams already love, and you will help define how we sell to larger organisations as the segment takes shape. You will work closely with Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Partnerships and Product, so your voice carries weight. n8n is growing at an exceptional pace, backed by a vibrant community and a remote-first culture built on autonomy, experimentation and high talent density. Apply now and help us bring AI-powered automation to the world’s most ambitious companies.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

title: Account Executive (Remote from Net)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Netherlands.

As an Account Executive – EMEA, you will drive new business development and strategic account growth across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, helping shape the future of AI-powered engineering and semiconductor design. You will introduce innovative physics simulation technology to leading semiconductor and electronics organizations, demonstrating its value in optimizing hardware development and manufacturing workflows. Combining new customer acquisition with strategic account expansion, you will build relationships with technical experts, business leaders, and C-level executives. You will lead complex enterprise sales cycles, develop regional partnerships, and create demand in an emerging technology market. Working closely with engineering, pre-sales, and product teams, you will ensure successful customer evaluations and long-term adoption. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious sales professional to influence an evolving industry while taking ownership of a strategic international territory.


Accountabilities

  • Strategic Account Management: Build and maintain strong relationships within key enterprise accounts across EMEA, identifying business units and opportunities where advanced physics simulation technology can deliver measurable business value.

  • New Business Development: Identify, prospect, and develop new strategic customers, generating demand and establishing relationships with technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.

  • Account Expansion: Drive both new customer acquisition and growth within existing accounts, developing land-and-expand strategies across complex engineering organizations.

  • Partner Ecosystem Development: Build and manage relationships with resellers, service providers, distributors, and strategic channel partners to increase regional market reach, generate customer introductions, and accelerate adoption.

  • Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Manage the entire enterprise sales process, from prospecting and discovery to value proposition development, technical evaluations, contract negotiations, and closing high-value deals.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with pre-sales, forward-deployment, and engineering teams to coordinate customer test cases and pilot deployments, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical requirements.

  • Pipeline Management and Forecasting: Maintain a strong and accurate sales pipeline, targeting at least four times quota coverage while providing clear forecasts and visibility into opportunity progression.

  • Market and Competitive Intelligence: Gather customer insights, partner feedback, regional market trends, and competitive intelligence to inform product development and commercial strategy.

  • Strategic Customer Engagement: Navigate complex organizational structures and engage effectively with technical individual contributors, domain experts, senior executives, and decision-makers.

  • Regional Market Development: Represent the business across EMEA, regularly traveling to strategic customer locations and partner organizations to develop relationships and advance commercial opportunities.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 7 years of experience in enterprise software sales, ideally as a major account manager or enterprise account executive within the semiconductor or electronics industry.

  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual sales quotas of $2 million or more and closing complex, high-value deals ranging from six to seven figures.

  • Strong understanding of the semiconductor ecosystem, including Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools, fabless and Integrated Device Manufacturer (IDM) business models, and advanced packaging technologies such as 2.5D and 3D IC.

  • Established network of senior decision-makers and industry contacts within major semiconductor, electronics, or engineering organizations across EMEA.

  • Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and commercial value propositions to VP-level and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to discuss physics simulation concepts and their applications in design, validation, and manufacturing workflows without relying on sales engineers for every customer interaction.

  • Demonstrated experience selling through and managing partner ecosystems, including resellers, distributors, service providers, or other channel relationships.

  • Strong strategic account planning, prospecting, negotiation, and closing skills.

  • Ability to operate autonomously, build relationships from the ground up, and create demand in markets where product categories and purchasing budgets may not yet be established.
