  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, combined with a proactive, entrepreneurial, and results-driven mindset.

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

title: Dutch speaking Support Specialist
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

As part of Lightspeed’s Support team, you will be the first point of contact for our customers who need assistance, helping with a wide variety of requests all the way from general education to hardware/software investigation and everything in between.

Working closely with various global teams at Lightspeed, you will investigate, troubleshoot, test and resolve issues that our hospitality customers may be facing during service.

 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Working with a truly global, multi-language 24x7 team across APAC, EMEA and NOAM

  • Flexibility on working days and shifts (weekends included)

  • Have enthusiastic, positive and knowledgeable interactions with our Hospitality customers, partners and Lightspeed team members, maintaining Lightspeed's Gold Class standard for support via phone, chat and email.

  • Use consistent troubleshooting techniques to quickly and efficiently identify the source of customer issues and provide a prompt and appropriate solution

  • Work within our customer support platforms to document, track and resolve interactions

  • Assist with the identification, reproduction and escalation of product issues and bugs to the Quality Assurance team, tracking through to resolution with each customer, partner and Lightspeed team member

  • Advocate and promote improvements to our products and services

  • Operating within a roster/schedule to ensure high availability of our assistance for our customers (In collaboration with your manager)

 

What you’ll be bringing to the team:

  • Previous customer service experience and/or technical support Strong attention to detail with an emphasis on providing an exceptional customer experience

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Dutch & English

  • Basic experience using common online, mobile and desktop platforms; iOS, Android, OSX, Windows

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

  • Experience interacting with customers through Phone, Email, Ticketing and Live Chat platforms

  • Experience or knowledge of the Hospitality industry

  • Experience supporting a SaaS product

  • Experience supporting an iOS application

  • Computer networking experience or interest

 

Even better if you have, but not necessary

  • Passion in technology;

  • Working knowledge of Mac OS and basic knowledge of HTML/CSS;

  • Hospitality experience;

  • French written and verbal communication skills;

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!


Please make sure to apply with a CV in English.


What’s in it for you:

  • PTO scheme

  • 400€ annually towards Health and Wellbeing

  • Dental cover

  • Private healthcare

  • Optical cover

  • Opportunity to join a growing team, in a fast-paced, high-growth company

  • Work with a team of incredibly talented and forward-thinking people!

  • Work for a team that values hard work, and knows how to celebrate the wins

  • Amazing benefits & perks, including equity for all Lightspeeders

In short, an opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed family, a true Canadian tech success story.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

title: ABM Specialist
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Role context

This role sits on our Customer Growth Marketing team, inside the account-based marketing (ABM) program that drives site expansion within our existing Enterprise and Mid-Market customers.. You will run the campaigns that introduce MaintainX to new sites and departments, keeping the expansion pipeline growing as targets rise.

The role

You will own the execution behind our ABM programs, so we reach more of our named accounts with timely, relevant campaigns.

  • Run our paid ABM programs on LinkedIn and programmatic: build audiences from account lists and signals, shift budget and creative based on engagement, and test new channels as budget grows. Plan and launch coordinated campaigns across webinars, events, email, and direct mail, timed to account activity and Sales priorities, so Sales has a relevant touchpoint when an account shows buying signals.

  • Set up and QA campaigns in our ABM and marketing tools, and keep account and contact data clean so we reach the right people.

  • Write briefs for ads and landing pages for Creative and keep a refresh calendar, so no campaign goes stale.

  • Report on campaign results and bring your own ideas for one-to-few and one-to-one account plays, so we can go after more high-value accounts.

You will work closely with our Senior Manager, ABM, who sets strategy and signal design, and partner with Sales, Customer Success, Events, and Content. Within 6 to 12 months, you will run our paid programs independently, own your pipeline KPIs, and have designed account plays of your own.

About you

  • 4+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with hands-on paid digital, ABM, or demand generation experience

  • Experience managing paid campaigns, ideally on LinkedIn and programmatic, and optimizing for pipeline quality rather than volume

  • A track record of executing multi-channel campaigns end to end, ideally ABM campaigns

  • Working knowledge of Outreach (or similar) and Salesforce

  • Strong project management across many campaigns and deadlines at once

  • Comfort pulling performance data, spotting trends, and explaining what they mean

  • Initiative and comfort with ambiguity: you do well in a high-growth environment where priorities pivot

Nice to have:

  • Experience with ABM or sales intelligence tools (UserGems, ZoomInfo, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense)

  • Experience with direct mail or other offline ABM tactics

  • Background in industrial or operations software

We offer

  • Work in the physical world. The accounts you target run factories, fleets, and facilities, and when our software works, their lines stay up.

  • A product the industry already loves. Customers who choose us renew and expand, so you are building on something that already wins.

  • Autodesk scale, same mission. MaintainX is part of Autodesk Operations Solutions (AOS), which brings Autodesk’s global reach to the problem we were already solving.

  • An early seat. This program is scaling fast, and the account plays we have not had capacity to run are yours to design.

Values and how we work

We reward output and promote quickly when people deliver. We hire for what you have shipped, not what your title was. You get autonomy and the trust to use it, and we expect you to bring ideas rather than wait to be asked. Priorities shift in a company growing this fast, and we say so openly.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

title: Account Executive - Operators
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

About Operators at MaintainX

Machine operators, line workers, and other frontline crews far outnumber maintenance technicians on most plant floors, and they touch the equipment every shift. The MaintainX operator module puts them on the same platform as maintenance.

The Account Executive – Operators will be dedicated to operator sales, helping manufacturers bring their whole frontline workforce onto MaintainX.

Role Overview

As an Account Executive – Operators, you will own the sales motion for expanding MaintainX to operators, which is an important area of growth and already has meaningful revenue. You will join deals owned by our Account Executives, Account Managers and Account Directors to find the frontline workforce inside each customer, size it, build the business case, and close.

You will work with plant and operations leaders to expand MaintainX across their sites.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Product and Marketing, and what you hear in the field will shape how we sell and build for operators. This is a “Co-Sell” position, working with MaintainX Sellers and working with the Senior Manager, New Product Sales to build out the Operator sales motion playbook.

What You'll Do

Own the Operators sales motion

  • Run the operator side of deals alongside the account owner: discovery, seat sizing, business case, demos, trials, pricing, and close.

  • Follow up quickly on leads and turn them into qualified pipeline.

  • Partner with Account Managers, Account Directors and CSMs on prospecting to find operator expansion in existing customers, and with AEs to add operators to new deals.

Deeply understand the plant floor

  • Engage plant, operations, EHS and maintenance leaders to learn where opportunities exist to add operators to MaintainX.

  • Map customer use cases to MaintainX, including TPM and autonomous maintenance, pre-use inspections, quality checks, and problem reporting.

  • Quantify impact in downtime and micro-stoppages avoided, scrap and rework reduced, paperwork hours saved, and safety gains.

Run trials and pilots that prove value

  • Structure trials and pilots that prove value fast and set up a broader rollout.

  • Work with Solutions Consultants, CSMs and Implementation to define success criteria, timelines, and rollout plans.

  • Translate trial results into clear business outcomes and ROI for plant and operations leadership.

Tell a differentiated story

  • Deliver tailored demos and executive presentations that show operators and maintenance working in one system.

  • Position MaintainX against paper, standalone checklist apps and other vendors.

  • Share field feedback and competitive insights with Product and Marketing to sharpen messaging and inform the operator roadmap.

Operate with excellence

  • Keep operator opportunities and forecasts clean and current in Salesforce.

  • Hand off cleanly to Implementation and Customer Success so operators are live soon after the deal closes.

  • Help shape the Operators sales playbook: coach account teams on operator discovery, pricing and objection handling, and bring what works back to sales enablement.

About You

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including selling into manufacturing, logistics, food & beverage or other asset-intensive environments.

  • Hustle mentality - “If you lose a day, you lost a week. If you lose a week you lost the month. If you lose a month, you lost the quarter.”

  • A track record of beating quota, ideally including expansion deals in existing accounts.

  • Strong value selling and discovery skills, especially sizing a frontline workforce and building an ROI case around downtime, quality, labor and safety.

  • Comfortable as an overlay: you join deals other sellers own, add value from the first call, and help the MaintainX sales team win.

  • Clear, confident presenter to plant managers and operations executives, comfortable running a live demo on a phone.

  • Highly organized, with strong pipeline management and forecasting discipline.

  • You like building something new: testing plays, keeping what works, and helping write the playbook as it takes shape.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

title: Sales Engineer II | EDU
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. The Sales Engineer II’s (SE II) primary role is to partner with the Sales Department and work alongside Account Executives to achieve sales and billings goals, with a focus on education customers, including K-12 school districts and higher education institutions. This position will evaluate technical requirements of education opportunities and present technical solutions that help schools, districts, and campuses deliver secure, well-managed Apple device programs for students and staff.

This is a remote position available to individuals residing in the Midwest Territory areas. While the role is remote, you may be asked to work occasionally from the Jamf office or a local collaborative workspace alongside other Jamf team members for key events or important in-person engagements. Please note that we are only able to consider applicants who are currently based in the Midwest Territory areas.

What you can expect to do this role:

  • Customer Facing Responsibilities
    • Work jointly with the Jamf Sales team, prospective and existing education customers, and partners to convey the business value of Jamf in classrooms, districts, and campuses
    • Gain a clear understanding of education customer requirements, such as student and staff device lifecycle, instructional app deployment, student privacy, and compliance obligations, and clearly outline how to address those requirements via the Jamf Portfolio
    • Own all presales technical activities by providing presentation, demonstration, and evaluation experiences tailored to educational environments for prospective and existing customers
    • Cultivate and maintain long-term relationships with K-12 and higher education customers to progress Jamf portfolio awareness and investmen
  • SE Team Responsibilities
    • Contribute to special projects as assigned by SE Management to support initiatives that progress the Sales Engineering org, including education market initiatives, and Jamf as a whole
    • Supports and promotes a positive, inclusive workplace one in which the talents and strengths of our increasingly diverse workforce are welcomed, further developed, and manifested in our wor
  • Personal Responsibilities
    • Amass, and maintain knowledge of value and technical capabilities of all products in the Jamf portfolio,with particular depth in education workflows such as Apple School Managet, Managed Apple Accounts, and shared 1:1 device programs
    • Exhibit professional and timely written oral communication
    • Perform all job responsibilities in alignment with the core values, mission and the vision of the organization
    • #LIRemote

What we are looking for:

  • 3-5 years of technical sales, support, or services experience (Required)
  • Basic knowledge of the Jamf products (Preferred)
  • Basic understanding of Apple Enterprise Management technologies (Preferred)
  • Technical knowledge of typical security architecture, application security and identity management (preferred)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Experience in a commercial, government, or education environment


Education and Certifications

  • 4 Year / Bachelor's Degree (Required)
  • A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

For sales and commission-based roles, we post On-Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus estimated commission based on achieving 100% of performance targets. Commission is not guaranteed and varies based on individual performance results.

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

$73,000—$167,380 USD

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. description:

Experience and Skills

title: Payroll Tax Analyst
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you'll do at Jamf:

The Payroll Analyst supports accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery for Jamf's U.S. workforce while assisting with payroll processing for Jamf's international workforce. This role processes payroll and standard tax filings under established procedures, supports international payroll vendors on day-to-day matters, and escalates complex or novel tax and compliance issues to senior payroll staff.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Support U.S. payroll tax compliance by preparing standard federal, state, and local tax filings (Forms 941, 940, W-2, and W-3) for review, and assist with reconciling tax liabilities against the general ledger.
  • Process semimonthly U.S. payroll — wages, deductions, benefits, and garnishments — across multiple states in Workday, following established payroll procedures.
  • Research routine payroll tax notices and agency correspondence, escalating complex or novel issues to senior payroll or tax staff.
  • Support year-end processing, including W-2 preparation and reconciliation.
  • Support payroll processing for Jamf employees outside the U.S. by coordinating with in-country payroll providers on day-to-day pay accuracy and timeliness.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned international payroll vendors, flagging discrepancies for review before disbursement.
  • Process and audit garnishments, levies, and voluntary deductions in compliance with applicable law.
  • Coordinate with HR, Legal, and Finance on standard multi-state and multi-country payroll matters, escalating complex tax or compliance questions as needed.
  • Use AI-powered tools alongside other payroll technologies to support validation and reconciliation tasks, flagging anomalies for review.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned.

What we are looking for:

  • 2+ years of federal, state, and local payroll tax rules — FICA, FUTA, SUTA, and withholding (required)

Are you eager to launch your sales career in a fast-growing, innovative tech company? Temporal is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to join our team in Singapore. As a BDR, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving growth by connecting with potential customers, generating leads, and building strong pipelines for our sales team.

This is an entry level role designed for ambitious self-starters who are passionate about technology, thrive in fast-paced environments, and are excited to develop their careers in sales. With a dedicated training program and clear growth path, you’ll have the support and tools to become a standout sales professional while contributing to Temporal’s mission of redefining application development.

What You'll Do

  • Proactively outbound prospecting and lead activity management in an effort to qualify and market Temporal to potential customers.

  • Discover opportunities from leads and set appointments from those leads.

  • Use of strong selling and influencing skills to set up qualified appointments.

  • Understand the Temporal OSS and Cloud solutions enough to provide high level introduction.

  • Leverage taught sales techniques to maximize customer interactions.

  • Log, track, and maintain outbound activity.

  • Ability to prioritize work assignments and shift work efforts based on the needs of the department or business goals.

  • Ability to manage time effectively, work independently, and be self-motivated

  • Prior track record of achievement in positions with accountability.

title: Lohnbuchhalter / Payroll Specialist (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns

Mammutmarsch heißt Abenteuer. Mammutmarsch heißt Grenzen sprengen. Wir organisieren Extremwanderungen in Deutschland und Europa, bei denen Menschen über sich hinauswachsen. Hinter unseren Events steht ein starkes Team aus Festangestellten und Event-HelferInnen. Damit im Hintergrund alles reibungslos läuft, suchen wir dich als LohnbuchhalterIn in Teilzeit (15 Std./Woche, 100 % remote) - jemanden, der die Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung eigenverantwortlich im Griff hat und Lust auf ein dynamisches Umfeld hat.

Dein Impact

Du sorgst dafür, dass unser gesamtes Team – vom Office-Mitarbeitenden bis zu den HelferInnen auf der Strecke - pünktlich, korrekt und reibungslos abgerechnet wird. Damit schaffst du Vertrauen, hältst dem Team den Rücken frei und bist der verlässliche Anker für alle Themen rund um Gehalt, Sozialversicherung und Meldewesen.

So arbeiten wir

Remote-first, unkompliziert und verbindlich. Wir schätzen kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Kommunikation und Menschen, die ihr Fachgebiet souverän im Griff haben. Bei uns arbeitest du eigenverantwortlich und im engen Austausch mit HR, Accounting und unserem Steuerbüro.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Monatliche Entgeltabrechnung: Du führst die laufenden Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungen für unsere Mitarbeitenden durch - inklusive Arbeitszeiten, Überstunden, Urlaub, Krankheit und Auslagen.

  • Event- & Beschäftigungsarten: Du prüfst und rechnest neben Festangestellten und Minijobbern auch unsere Event-Helfer:innen („Edelhelfer“) rechtssicher ab.

  • Melde- & Bescheinigungswesen: Du übernimmst An- und Abmeldungen, pflegst laufende Stammdatenänderungen und kümmerst dich um Sozialversicherungs-, Lohnsteuer- und Krankenkassenmeldungen sowie Erstattungsanträge.

  • Systempflege & Zahlungen: Du verwaltest und pflegst unser Abrechnungssystem und kontrollierst bzw. veranlasst die monatlichen Gehaltszahlungen.

  • Ansprechperson & Schnittstelle: Du stehst Mitarbeitenden, Krankenkassen, Finanzämtern und unserem Steuerbüro kompetent bei lohnsteuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlichen Fragen zur Seite.

Was du mitbringst

  • Spezialisiertes Know-how: Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit fundierter Berufserfahrung in der eigenständigen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung.

  • Sicherheit im Lohnsteuer- & SV-Recht: Du kennst dich bestens mit verschiedenen Beschäftigungsarten (Voll-/Teilzeit, Minijobs, kurzfristige Beschäftigungen/Event-Aushilfen) aus.

  • System-Erfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit gängiger Abrechnungssoftware; idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit Sage HR & Payroll mit.

  • Sorgfalt & Verlässlichkeit: Eine strukturierte, diskrete und termintreue Arbeitsweise, auf die sich das gesamte Team verlassen kann.

  • Sprache: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Unser Versprechen an dich

  • 100 % Remote & maximale Flexibilität: Arbeite komplett ortsunabhängig in Deutschland und teile dir deine 15 Stunden pro Woche - außerhalb der festen Abrechnungsstichtage - flexibel ein.

  • Planbarer Rahmen: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und direktem Kontakt zu HR und Geschäftsführung.

  • Das Mammutmarsch-Gemeinschaftsgefühl: Ein wertschätzendes Team, das zusammenhält und deine Arbeit im Hintergrund genauso feiert wie den Zieleinlauf auf der Strecke.

  • Kurze Wege: Pragmatische Lösungen statt endloser Abstimmungsschleifen.

Deine Bewerbung

Klingt nach dir? Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Anschreiben genügt) und 2–3 Sätze, warum du Lust auf Lohnbuchhaltung beim Mammutmarsch hast. Wir melden uns in der Regel innerhalb von fünf Tagen bei dir zurück.

title: Marketing Internship - Summer 2027
description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services – embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems – to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students and new graduates who already use AI to build and solve problems to join our paid summer internship program. You’ll gain hands-on experience at a fast-growing, remote-first B2B SaaS company developing AI-powered products that help organizations upskill their people and fuel long-term growth.

As an intern, you’ll collaborate with experienced teammates across the company to help shape the future of OpenSesame. You’ll work on meaningful projects that bring new ideas to life, strengthen the customer experience, and help customers achieve success.

AI is how we work here, not a side topic. You’ll have access to AI tools, including Claude, and we’ll encourage you to use them to research, prototype, analyze, and build. You’ll explore how AI and data can inform strategy, improve customer outcomes, and shape the future of learning technology, and see how human-centered design and AI innovation combine to create products with global impact.

Intern AI Hackathon

As part of your internship you will have the opportunity to participate in our first intern AI hackathon this summer. You’ll team up with interns from other departments to pitch, build with AI, and present a working product idea that improves how OpenSesame works or serves customers.

About the Marketing Team

The Marketing team blends creativity and data to craft innovative strategies that drive brand recognition, boost lead generation, and deepen customer engagement. Working cross-functionally, the team aligns marketing initiatives with OpenSesame’s mission while ensuring campaigns deliver measurable, high-impact results.

Performance Objectives

By 2 Weeks

  • Learn OpenSesame’s core marketing ecosystem, tools, and HubSpot workflows spanning growth, product, and customer marketing.
  • Partner with product marketing on launch planning, competitive analysis, and preliminary collateral development.
  • Begin contributing to customer marketing programs like customer interviews and case studies.
  • Document marketing processes to support team scalability and efficiency.

By 30 Days

  • Partner with growth and product teams on core initiatives, including webinar program execution, optimization, and lead generation strategies.
  • Drive engagement by creating social media campaigns and experimenting with AI tools for creativity and reach.
  • Build HubSpot assets, support customer marketing collateral, and help ensure website user experience is top-notch.
  • Contribute to early-stage content distribution flywheels and ongoing competitive positioning research.

By 60 Days

  • Become an essential partner to the marketing team, offering insights and creative solutions that help drive our projects forward.
  • Take ownership of a project that will enhance a key aspect of OpenSesame’s marketing efforts, this is your chance to shine.
  • Develop a plan to optimize our marketing campaigns using data-driven insights, making sure we’re always one step ahead.

Application and Creative Project

Before you start, check out our Creative Project guide. It walks through what we're looking for below in more detail.

To apply, submit one application, which includes a link to your creative project. We want to see how you think and what you've built, so your creative project must be a video (5 minutes or less), shared as a YouTube link (unlisted is fine). Applications without a working YouTube link will not be reviewed.

We care more about your curiosity and how you think than a polished result, so don't let your experience level stop you from applying.

You can talk to the camera, or walk us through slides, a demo, or a screen recording. How you show it is up to you. In your video, please cover:

  • How do you see OpenSesame fitting into your career journey or long-term goals?
  • What strengths, skills, or perspectives do you bring to OpenSesame to make an impact and contribute to our mission?
  • Show us something you've built with AI. What problem did you solve, and what excites you about where AI is taking learning and work?
    • Haven't built anything with AI yet? Make something today! Try an AI tool, experiment with a new idea, and show us or walk us through how you did it.
    • Feel free to share something from your personal life, work, school, or anywhere else. Share whatever feels right to you.

We're drawn to curiosity, creativity, growth mindset and authentic expression. Keep it concise and focused.

Not selected for this role? You're still in the running. We'll review your application for alignment with our other open internships. If we see a potential fit, we'll reach out to you directly.

Additional Program Details

Application closes: Sunday, February 14th, 2027

Program dates: Anticipated start June 17, 2027 through August 28th, 2027. We can adjust up to two weeks earlier for students returning to school before the program concludes.

Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Eligibility and location: Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted). This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation: $20 an hour

Equipment: Interns must have a personal computer with specs suitable for the work and access to consistent high-speed internet during working hours.

Opportunities and expectations: OpenSesame's internship program is immersive and growth-focused, pairing each intern with a dedicated mentor and offering meaningful, hands-on projects that make an impact. You'll also take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, the intern hackathon, and book club discussions, receive volunteer time off to give back to your community, and gain full access to our course catalog for your own learning and development.

Interview process: After the application review, selected candidates will be invited to a virtual OpenSesame webinar to learn more about our company, culture, and internship program. Following the event, selected candidates will move forward to interviews with the hiring manager and team for the department they're being considered for.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

CPRA (California candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

title: Power Platform Technical Architect
description:
Ludia Consulting is one of the fastest growing and innovative consulting firms in Microsoft Dynamics Finance & Supply Chain, Customer Engagement and Power Platform. We are looking for a team member that is committed to helping others and their communities while also growing professionally as part of our Ludia family.

We are not just a traditional organization; we are driven to help our partners and clients while delivering value every day. Our team members are also encouraged to grow by sharing their knowledge and experience through a multitude of community-driven channels, including local non-profit organizations.

The Role

As a Power Platform Technical Architect, you will be a key aspect of our mission to translate business and functional requirements into scalable, secure technical architectures using modern design principles and best practices in software development for our customers and internal initiatives. You will own the technical and integration architecture for client engagements, set technical direction and standards for delivery teams, and communicate architectural decisions, effort estimates, and risks to solution architects, management, and clientele.

This position combines deep hands-on technical expertise with an equally important emphasis on architectural judgment and technical leadership. To achieve success, our architects demonstrate the ability to learn quickly, communicate ideas effectively, define and lead team efforts and utilize flexibility and creativity to present a variety of solutions. You must have excellent communication, analytical, architecture, and technical leadership skills to excel in this role.

Essential Functions

  • Own the end-to-end technical architecture for Power Platform and Dynamics 365 engagements, leading technical discovery, requirements analysis, evaluation of solution options, and design decisions with client and project stakeholders.
  • Architect Dataverse solutions and guide their configuration and development using model-driven apps, Power Automate cloud flows, business rules, Power Fx, and other platform capabilities, remaining hands-on for complex or high-risk components.
  • Determine when and how to extend the platform using C#, .NET, plug-ins, custom APIs, JavaScript, Dataverse Web API, REST APIs, and custom connectors, and establish coding standards and reusable patterns for those extensions.
  • Define the integration architecture and patterns for secure inbound and outbound integrations using Dataverse and relevant Azure services, including authentication, error handling, retry behavior, performance, and operational support.
  • Define logical data models, data mappings, migration and synchronization approaches, alternate keys, and data-quality controls.
  • Define non-functional requirements and design for security, scalability, performance, service protection limits, licensing, and cost.
  • Establish Dataverse security models and platform governance, including environment strategy, Managed Environments, and DLP policies.
  • Author and govern architecture artifacts, including technical designs, architecture decision records, integration diagrams, process flows, estimates, assumptions, risks, deployment plans, runbooks, and support documentation.
  • Define and govern the application lifecycle management strategy using solutions, dependency and layer management, environment variables, connection references, source control, Power Platform Pipelines, and CI/CD automation.
  • Establish quality standards and lead code and design reviews, test strategy, solution validation, performance and capacity planning, and release readiness.
  • Serve as the technical escalation point for complex production issues, lead root-cause analysis, and define monitoring and supportability standards for managed services.
  • Lead technical walkthroughs, communicate progress and risks, mentor and develop consultants and developers, and collaborate effectively across disciplines and time zones.
  • Support pre-sales and scoping by shaping technical approaches, validating estimates, and identifying delivery risks for proposals and statements of work.
  • Maintain current knowledge of the platform roadmap and shape internal practices, reference architectures, reusable assets, and knowledge sharing.

Skills & Competencies

  • At least eight years of hands-on consulting or development experience with Microsoft Power Platform and Dynamics 365, including at least two years in a technical architect or technical lead role.
  • Experience delivering multiple end-to-end enterprise Power Platform or Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement implementations as the lead technical architect or technical lead.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Dataverse, model-driven apps, Power Automate cloud flows, data modeling, and platform configuration.
  • Practical development experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript, REST APIs, and Dataverse extension patterns.
  • Deep expertise in synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns, authentication, error handling, performance, and supportability, including Azure integration services such as Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, API Management, and Key Vault.
  • Experience with solution-based application lifecycle management, source control, automated deployments, and tools such as Power Platform CLI, Azure DevOps, or GitHub.
  • Experience designing Dataverse security and troubleshooting application, automation, integration, and deployment issues.
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation, develop reliable estimates, identify risks and assumptions, and explain and defend architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, organization, prioritization, and collaboration skills, including experience working independently within distributed teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor technical teams, set design and coding standards, and review the work of developers and consultants.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with canvas apps or Power Pages.
  • Experience with Dynamics 365 finance and operations apps, dual-write, virtual tables, or integrations spanning Customer Engagement and finance and operations apps.
  • Working knowledge of Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse Link for Dataverse, Azure Data Lake, or related analytics capabilities.
  • Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI Builder, agents, or AI-enabled business applications.
  • Experience with Purview governance or the Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and Azure licensing and cost considerations.
  • Microsoft Certified: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect Expert credential, a previously earned Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or Power Platform Developer Associate credential, or equivalent demonstrated architecture expertise.

Benefits / Why Ludia

  • Vast network of professional connections
  • Team focused, no-blame culture
  • Opportunities for professional growth
  • Family/Community focused company
  • Remote work-from-home
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Generous bonus structure
  • Full health benefits, vision, and dental
  • 401K
  • …and more!

Ludia Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, or status with regard to public assistance.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

If you're technically sharp, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to be the German-speaking specialist our DACH+ clients rely on, we'd love to hear from you. Komm an Bord!

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 230,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.

That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first.

As our new Paid Media Specialist, you'll plan, run, and optimize paid social advertising campaigns for Kinsta. You'll join our Performance Marketing team, report to the Paid Media Team Lead, and work closely with Demand Generation, Design, and RevOps to deliver a consistent volume of sign-ups and revenue that supports Kinsta's growth goals. It's a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable with data and enjoys testing new ideas.

Your focus is Kinsta's paid social presence across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms. You'll reach the businesses, agencies, and enterprises that run their sites on WordPress, through campaigns that cover the full funnel from awareness to customer acquisition.

You'll own campaigns from build to optimization, keep conversion tracking reliable, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. We work with teams across the globe, so you should be used to collaborating asynchronously and flexible enough to join the occasional early or late call. The ideal Kinsta Paid Media Specialist is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, proactive, and collaborative.

What You Will Do:

Plan, build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms, covering the full funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Monitor performance and continuously optimize targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, ad creatives, and landing pages, scaling what works while keeping acquisition costs efficient.

Run audience research and competitive analysis to find new opportunities for growth.

Develop and run A/B tests across ad messaging, creative assets, audiences, and landing pages.

Own conversion tracking: implement, maintain, and troubleshoot it through Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform-specific pixels and tags, and work with marketing and technical teams to keep conversion events and attribution accurate.

Analyze campaign performance using ad platform data, web analytics, and CRM reporting, and build reports and dashboards that share results and actionable insights.

Collaborate with content, design, product marketing, and sales on ad copy, creative concepts, and campaign assets that match our messaging and business priorities.

Support our paid media strategy: follow advertising trends and platform updates, and recommend ways to improve campaign efficiency, lead quality, and overall marketing ROI.

Use AI tools to streamline research, reporting, ad copy, and creative ideation, automate repetitive tasks, and apply critical thinking to AI-generated recommendations so decisions stay grounded in accurate data and business objectives.

What You Bring To The Role:

2-4 years of hands-on experience independently building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns, including on Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit, ideally in hosting, B2B technology, or a related industry.

Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags.

A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations.

Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once.

Bonus if you have:

Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms.

Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack.

Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites.

Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.

Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns

Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development.

Our Benefits:

Annual remote expense budget.

Flexible PTO.

Paid parental leave.

Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta.

Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter).

Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary.

Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA.

Kinsta is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteranâs status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

By applying to one of our positions, you agree to the processing of the submitted personal data in accordance with Kinsta's Privacy Policy, including the transfer of your data to the United States.

title: Cloud Security Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
About the role:

​

As a Cloud Security Engineer, you will be a significant key function of our Global IT Team and design, implement and continuously improves security controls across our global cloud, identity and SaaS landscape. The role translates security architecture into practical, automated and secure-by-default controls, with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID. With our world-class team, you will play a pivotal role in pushing the boundaries of drone technology. ​

You will work closely with stakeholders from R&D, Global IT, Enterprise Risk and subsidiaries to ensures that security is built into technology decisions by design, while enabling teams to move quickly and securely. With risk-oriented judgment and hands-on mentality, you will support Quantum Systems in its mission to become the benchmark for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV).​

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design and implement security controls across Azure, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID.​

  • Engineer Zero Trust, Conditional Access, phishing-resistant MFA, PIM/PAM and workload identity controls.​

  • Build cloud security baselines using Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud and Infrastructure as Code.​

  • Secure cloud networking, Key Vault, certificates, secrets, encryption and privileged access.​

  • Identify and remediate cloud vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, excessive permissions and attack paths.​

  • Ensure relevant cloud, identity and M365 security telemetry is available to SIEM/XDR and SOC.​

  • Automate security controls and remediation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, Terraform/Bicep and KQL.​

  • Support security incidents involving cloud services, identities and privileged access.​

  • Work closely with Security Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering and SOC teams.​




What you bring to the team:

  • You have a degree/ completed training in the field of Informatics, Cyber Security or comparable field experience​

  • You already have at least +5 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud or security engineering.​

  • Broad technical knowledge across Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Defender XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, GitHub Enterprise, Terraform and Kubernetes.​

  • Strong understanding of IAM, Zero Trust, RBAC, PIM/PAM and Conditional Access..​

  • Practical knowledge of cloud networking, logging, vulnerability management and security automation.​

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and scripting/automation.​

  • Strong communication skills across engineering teams, technical leadership and management.​

  • Communication in English is a matter of course for you.​

  • Relevant certifications such as AZ-500, SC-100, CISSP or CCSP are beneficial but not mandatory.​

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations.

At Quantum Systems, you’ll work alongside experts across disciplines, take ownership from day one and help turn ambitious ideas into technology with real-world impact. We move fast, think beyond boundaries and give our teams the space to shape what comes next.

The Future is Unmanned - But the responsibility is not.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As a freelancer for KAYAK, you will be collaborating with a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Freelance Market Specialist for the German market to support our Localization and Product Marketing teams at KAYAK. This unique role combines the strategic elements of product marketing with the linguistic expertise required for high-quality localization. The ideal candidate will improve our messaging, positioning, and in-product communications while ensuring the highest standards of linguistic quality and cultural relevance in our localized content.

Are you passionate about translating product marketing strategies into resonating copies to attract your local audience? Then join us at Booking Holdings and help craft the future of travel!

In this role, you will:

  • Product Marketing Support:

    • Develop and refine concise, user-friendly messaging for KAYAK’s features and unique selling propositions (USPs).

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create a unified product positioning and messaging framework.

  • Localization Quality Assurance:

    • Evaluate the quality of Machine Translation (MT) or AI-generated content, and fully localize the content to improve the user engagement.

Please apply if you have:

  • Native-level proficiency in German and excellent command of English.

  • Strong writing, communication, and proofreading skills with an attention to detail.

  • Strong understanding of cultural nuances and ability to adapt content accordingly.

  • Familiarity with CAT tools is a plus.

  • Understanding of the challenges and considerations when working with MT or AI-generated content.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote setting.

  • Ideally based in the local market to stay on top of the local marketing trends.

title: Scientist - Patient Stratification, Biomarkers, Translational Genomics
description:
Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores – giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

A Day in the Life

At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health.

This role is part of the Life Sciences team, working on a range of challenges spanning the therapeutic development cycle, with a particular focus on developing patient stratification strategies, advancing disease understanding using ‘omic data, and identifying novel biomarkers. The Scientist is an early-career member of the team, who will thrive in a highly collaborative team environment. With the team’s support, you will develop and execute innovative and rigorous scientific approaches, and will effectively communicate findings to both internal and external stakeholders.

For example, a Scientist may:

  • Apply and optimise risk tools for patient stratification that combine genetic information, through polygenic risk scores, with conventional risk factors, to find the individuals most at risk of disease onset or progression and those most likely to benefit from therapies.

  • Cluster genetic variants by their effects on disease-relevant traits to reveal distinct biological mechanisms, and use partitioned polygenic scores to define patient subgroups that share underlying causal biology.

  • Discover and validate novel biomarkers from clinical or ‘omic data, and apply them to stratify patient populations in large biobanks or clinical trials.

To be successful in this role, you will: bring a strong foundation in the application of statistical and computational techniques in biomedical science that you can apply in innovative ways, thrive on analysing vast and diverse sources of ‘omic data using leading statistical or AI/ML approaches to make meaningful insights into complex problems, and take pride in effectively sharing your findings with others.

Who You Are

Essential:

  • Solid foundations in statistics (e.g., modelling, regression), genetics and molecular biology, and statistical programming (e.g., Python or R).

  • Experience using at least one of the following statistical genetics approaches: GWAS, colocalization, fine-mapping, Mendelian randomization, polygenic risk scores.

Preferred:

  • Experience defining phenotypes from electronic health records.

  • Knowledge of Bayesian inference, high dimensional statistics, causal inference.

  • Experience with software engineering practices (version control [Git & GitHub], testing, documentation, agentic coding)

  • Experience building and running reproducible pipelines, e.g., using WDL, Snakemake, or NextFlow.

  • Experience using cloud computing and trusted research environments, e.g., DNAnexus or Verily Workbench.

  • Experience with methods development within statistical genetics.

Your Package

We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment.

Compensation & Growth

  • Competitive Salary: Salaries are externally benchmarked annually to ensure competitive compensation.

  • Clear Career Path: A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal.

  • Continuous Learning: Including external courses and a wide library of L&D materials, because your growth is our success.

Wellbeing & Time Off

  • Holiday: 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, plus an extra 3-day company-wide shutdown at year-end.

  • Financial & Health Security: Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance.

  • Enhanced Leave: Enhanced paid family leave to support all new parents.

Work Environment & Culture

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid Working (e.g., from our London or Oxford Office)

  • Truly Inclusive Time Off: Our 'Bank Your Bank Holiday' program allows you to exchange public holidays for dates that hold personal or cultural significance to you.

  • Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate.

  • Green Commute: Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs.

Ready to Build the Future?
