title: Sustainability data advisor, financial services
description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

Leading financial institutions like Carlyle Group, KKR, Ares, and BBVA use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive portfolio decarbonization.

We are looking for a customer-focused and analytically minded individual to join our Sustainability Data Advisory team in London, with a focus on financial institutions. You'll join a small team that operates like a startup within a startup at Watershed, working with some of the world's leading asset managers, private equity firms, banks, and insurers to accelerate their sustainability strategies.

You'll work directly with customers as a trusted advisor, leading measurement sessions and delivering advisory services that unlock the full value of our platform. You'll help customers measure financed emissions and use insights from their footprint to inform reporting and decision-making.

You will:

  • Advise teams at the world's largest financial institutions. Work directly with customers to measure financed emissions and strengthen their sustainable finance programs, supporting portfolio decarbonization and reporting across frameworks including TCFD, SFDR, CSRD, and LP reporting.

  • Deliver services that accelerate customer success. Lead measurement sessions and provide specialized advisory to help customers set up measurements, improve data quality, and unlock value from Watershed's platform. Support customers through emissions verification when needed.

  • Collaborate with science, engineering, and product teams to apply innovative measurement solutions, interpret the Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials (PCAF) standards, and help customers make informed choices about how to measure emissions across asset classes.

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 4–6 years of experience in consulting, solutions engineering, another customer-facing role in sustainability. You are excited to work directly with customers to help them build world-class sustainability programs.

  • Have an understanding of PCAF methodology and experience applying it to financed emissions measurement.

  • Have experience working with financial institutions and understand how they use emissions to inform internal decision-making and sustainability strategies.

  • Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Learn quickly and operate well in ambiguity. You are organized, systematic, and efficient, and you thrive in a high-volume environment.

  • Think clearly about complex problems and are comfortable using and speaking to data. You are meticulous and detail-obsessed.

  • Are passionate about solving climate change and excited to contribute to doing so at a fast-paced startup.

Fluency in multiple languages—English, French, German, or Spanish—is a nice to have.

This position requires working in person in our London office four days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. But the moments that decide outcomes often happen elsewhere: at the point of injury, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.

Tricorder is building deployable clinical infrastructure for that world. It's a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It's a dual-use venture serving defence medical first and civilian pre-hospital and humanitarian care next.

Tricorder is being built inside Founders Factory's venture studio, with dedicated pre-seed investment and a six-month build programme. The founder, a former British Army officer, is in place, the founding engineer is incoming, and a few more team hires are underway.

What you'll do

You'll be Tricorder's senior clinical voice: the person who makes sure what we build works for a medic at the point of injury and keeps patients safe.

  • Shape clinical workflows: map how casualties are assessed, treated, handed over and evacuated, from the point of injury through to definitive care. Turn that into product requirements, and test prototypes against real resuscitation and trauma scenarios.

  • Protect patient safety: lead clinical risk management and act as (or help appoint) the Clinical Safety Officer under the NHS DCB0129 standard. Advise on the evidence needed for the medical device and regulatory pathway.

  • Be the medical face of the product: put your clinical name to Tricorder. Represent it to defence medical services, NHS and ambulance trusts, humanitarian organisations and investors, and help the founder carry the clinical story in pitches and pilots.

  • Open doors: use your network across defence medicine, the NHS and humanitarian response to secure clinical pilots, user testing and early design partners.

  • Guide clinical evidence: help design pilots and early studies, and review clinical claims, protocols and terminology across the product and its AI features.

  • Advise the team: be a sounding board for the founder and build team on clinical priorities. Help with clinical hiring as the company grows.

Who you are

Must-haves

  • You've served as a military medic or doctor. This is non-negotiable. You know operational medicine first-hand, from point-of-injury care to the field hospital.

  • A GMC-registered doctor with deep experience in resuscitation, trauma or emergency surgery, emergency medicine, or pre-hospital care.

  • Still active clinically, whether as a reservist, in the NHS, or in humanitarian or disaster response.

  • You're credible with senior defence medical leaders, NHS clinicians and investors, and comfortable being the named clinical lead for a product.

  • You can turn clinical reality into clear, practical product decisions, and you're happy working with engineers and designers at startup pace.

Nice to have

  • Experience advising or working with medtech or health-tech startups, ideally as a CMO, clinical lead or advisor.

  • Clinical Safety Officer training (DCB0129/DCB0160), or experience with medical device regulation (UKCA/CE, ISO 14971).

  • Leadership roles in defence medical services, such as a clinical lead, medical director or command role.

  • Experience with mass-casualty planning, deployed hospital care, or global health systems.

  • Familiarity with clinical AI, data standards or digital health interoperability.

Probably not the right fit if

  • You haven't served in a military medical role.

  • You're looking for a passive advisory title without hands-on involvement in the product.

description:
Outsight’s software solutions track the motion of people and vehicles using 3D LiDAR data.
Operators of transportation hubs like airports and train stations but also sport venues, road infrastructures and industrial sites can now access accurate and anonymous Spatial Intelligence data, in order to improve operations and increase user safety and satisfaction.
 
Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice), Singapore & Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain.
 
You can find below an interesting link about who we are and what we do :

Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across four continents, including the most renowned hubs celebrated for their operational excellence and exceptional passenger experience.  We also deploy our solutions in other markets such as Tourism, Retail and Sports.
Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW.
 
 
 
Position Overview :
 
As a Field Deployed Engineer in the Customer Delivery team, you are the customer's privileged point of contact for all aspects related to the deployment of our “Spatial Intelligence Platform” solutions intended for managers of public places (Airports, etc.) and “Real-time 3D perception” for developers of smart machines and systems (robotics, real-time mapping, automatic pilots, aerial inspection, etc.)

Serve as the primary technical contact for deploying our solutions in public spaces and smart infrastructures.
 
Lead product installations and manage customer feedback, ensuring a seamless experience from start to finish.
 
Analyze and resolve technical issues, contributing to product improvement.
 
Ensure customer Satisfaction. Develop and deliver training materials that help customers get the most out of the company's products and services.

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical, Industrial, Automotive, or Mechanical Engineering—or equivalent practical experience.

Strong problem-solving mindset and autonomous troubleshooting skills, especially in undocumented or fast-changing situations.
 
Clear communicator with the ability to simplify and explain complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Product Owner (H/F/N)
description:
Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne. 

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation. 

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. 

Vous rejoignez l’équipe Produit – R&PD 

Au sein de l’équipe R&PD (Research & Product Development) nous concevons et industrialisons des solutions Data & IA SaaS à fort impact business, qui répondent aux enjeux de nos clients grâce à l’analytics, la data science et l’intelligence artificielle.

A ce titre, nous recrutons un·e Product Owner pour notre solution Marketing Effectiveness avec pour objectif de structurer la  roadmap produit, maximiser son adoption, son time-to-market et la valeur délivrée à nos clients. 

Votre rôle dans l’équipe 

Product Owner de notre solution Marketing Effectiveness (Eki.Decisions), vous transformez les besoins business, marché et utilisateurs en fonctionnalités concrètes, documentées et alignées sur une logique de plateforme commune. 

Vous travaillez au quotidien avec le Product Manager, les équipes engineering et data, ainsi que les équipes projet et delivery, pour construire une solution fiable, adoptée et scalable. 

Vos principales missions 

Piloter le backlog et le delivery 

  • Structurer, prioriser et maintenir le backlog de la solution 

  • Rédiger les user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles et critères d’acceptance 

  • Clarifier les besoins avec l’engineering et accompagner chaque livraison de bout en bout 

  • Suivre l’avancement, lever les blocages et sécuriser les engagements 

  • Animer les rituels agiles : refinement, sprint planning, reviews, rétrospectives, synchronisations produit/tech 

  • Rendre la roadmap, les priorités et les arbitrages lisibles pour toutes les parties prenantes 

Contribuer à la vision produit 

  • Co-construire la vision et la roadmap avec le Product Manager 

  • Traduire les enjeux business et marché en opportunités produit concrètes : fonctionnalités, parcours utilisateurs, briques mutualisées, standards d’expérience 

  • Prioriser selon la valeur business, l’impact client, la contribution à la platformisation et la capacité à accélérer le time-to-market 

Participer à la product discovery 

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et des clients sur le Marketing Effectiveness 

  • Maîtriser les usages, comportements et règles métier qui font la valeur de la solution 

  • Identifier les enjeux fonctionnels et opérationnels : expérience utilisateur, cohérence des parcours, adoption, scalabilité, industrialisation 

  • Conduire ou contribuer aux activités de discovery : interviews, retours terrain, analyses d’usage, benchmarks 

Faire adopter et améliorer en continu 

  • Accompagner le déploiement des nouvelles fonctionnalités auprès des parties prenantes clés, avec une communication claire sur ce qui est livré 

  • Mesurer l’impact : adoption, satisfaction, valeur délivrée aux clients 

  • Animer la boucle de feedback avec les équipes Produit, Business, Tech et Delivery 

  • S’appuyer sur les outils de tracking pour monitorer les usages et prioriser de façon data-driven 

  • Garantir la qualité : documentation produit, release notes, support, monitoring d’usage 

Collaborer en transverse 

  • Travailler avec les équipes Produit, Tech, Data, IA et Delivery pour assurer la cohérence des solutions émergentes avec la plateforme 

  • Servir de relais entre les équipes business, produit, engineering et delivery 

  • Participer aux démonstrations, formations internes, retours d’expérience et communications produit 

Votre profil 

Expérience 

  • 3 ans minimum en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager 

  • Expérience sur des produits SaaS ou digitaux, idéalement dans un environnement data, IA ou tech

Compétences 

  • Forte appétence business : vous reliez les fonctionnalités à la valeur client et aux enjeux marché 

  • Aisance avec les profils tech : vous comprenez les enjeux d’un produit technique, sans avoir besoin d’être développeur·se 

  • Maîtrise du backlog : clarifier les besoins, prioriser des sujets complexes, suivre le delivery 

  • Logique de plateforme : mutualisation des usages, convergence des solutions, cohérence des parcours 

  • Sensibilité forte à l’expérience utilisateur, à l’adoption et à la qualité produit 

  • Capacité à vulgariser et à embarquer les parties prenantes autour d’une vision commune 

Savoir-être 

  • Organisé·e, rigoureux·se, autonome, curieux·se et orienté·e impact 

Langues 

  • Français et anglais courants, à l’écrit comme à l’oral 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  

Vous aurez accès :

  • Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
  • A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People.
  • De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté.
  • Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards).
  • Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.
 

En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

title: High Voltage Electrical Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will tackle some of the most demanding high-voltage engineering challenges in the energy industry, developing electrical systems that enable next-generation plasma heating technologies. Your expertise will directly influence the performance, reliability, and safety of critical plant systems, shaping the electrical backbone of a first-of-a-kind fusion power plant. By advancing high-voltage power conversion, insulation, protection, and system integration, you will help transform cutting-edge scientific concepts into industrial-scale reality.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead the engineering and integration of high-voltage power systems supporting critical plant operations

  • Define high-voltage electrical architectures, simulate power conversion and selection of electrical components

  • Perform and review key electrical studies, including insulation coordination, transient overvoltage, short-circuit protection, grounding, and safety analyses

  • Develop strategies for high-voltage system monitoring, diagnostics, and condition assessment to improve reliability and maintainability

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of high-voltage systems with plant infrastructure and control systems

  • Oversee testing, commissioning, and validation activities for high-voltage equipment and subsystems

  • Build a safety culture that protects our people first and equipment second, from the dangers inherent in high voltage systems

WHO YOU ARE

  • You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field

  • You have experience designing, analyzing, or commissioning high-voltage electrical systems in industrial, utility, research, or energy applications

  • You enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and developing innovative solutions where established approaches may not yet exist

  • Experience in the design and application of insulation systems, electric field management, and creepage and clearance coordination is a plus

  • Familiarity with protection systems, interlocking philosophies, and functional safety concepts for high-energy electrical installations is a plus

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Impact: Your work will directly shape the magnets that enable commercial fusion energy.

  • Ownership: As an early member of a growing team, you’ll help define how we test HTS at scale.

  • Development: Build specialist skills at the cutting edge of superconducting magnet technology.

1. Qualification at Scale

  • Test Planning: Define test strategies, sampling plans and pass/fail criteria for HTS tapes and cables, and help set up production testing at our Magnet Factory.

  • Measurement: Commission test systems and develop measurement processes that ensure reproducible, traceable measurements of critical current (Ic) and related properties, including the effects of manufacturing processes.

  • Data & Statistics: Help design our HTS test database, with traceability from supplier and reel through to cable, and turn results into statistical datasets for magnet modelling and design.

  • Technician Guidance: Write procedures and guide the technicians who run routine tests.

  • Safety: Ensure safe work with cryogens, high currents and high magnetic fields.

  • Quality: Ensure results are traceable, well documented and reproducible.

An engineer or scientist who enjoys careful, hands-on experimental work as much as planning how we test at scale.

  • You hold an MSc or PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • You speak fluent English.

  • You have strong data analysis skills and a solid grasp of measurement uncertainty and statistics.

  • You are happy to travel for test campaigns at external facilities, including internationally.

  • Experience with superconductors, cryogenics or high magnetic fields.

  • Experience with quality control or production testing at scale.

  • Experience designing cryogenic or automated test equipment.

  • Familiarity with HTS tape manufacturing processes and the supplier landscape.

  • German language skills.

title: Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts – English, German, Korean
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts – English, German, Korean based in Netherlands.

As an Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts, you will bridge the worlds of architecture, customer relationship management, and software development. You will showcase innovative building configurators to international customers, demonstrating how complex project requirements can be transformed into permit-ready building designs within minutes. Combining architectural expertise with technical understanding, you will adapt product demonstrations to different customer needs and evaluate new features from a practical planning perspective. You will also manage relationships with strategic accounts, understand their workflows, and translate operational challenges into actionable product requirements. Working closely with architects, engineers, and software developers, you will help improve product quality and ensure successful customer adoption. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to influence the future of digital building planning within an international, collaborative team.


Accountabilities:

You will combine product demonstrations, architectural quality assurance, and strategic account management to ensure that customers successfully adopt building configurators while providing valuable insights to improve the product.

  • Customer Demonstrations: Prepare and deliver engaging product demonstrations for customers and partners, primarily remotely and occasionally on-site, in English, German, or Korean.

  • Tailored Product Presentations: Adapt demonstrations to specific customer use cases, building types, and project requirements while explaining design logic, planning regulations, and generated outputs.

  • Architectural Quality Assurance: Test new features and configurators before release, evaluating generated site layouts, floor plans, and building models for architectural plausibility, buildability, and compliance with underlying rules.

  • Issue Identification & Documentation: Identify bugs, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities, documenting findings with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, and structured feedback.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with planning and algorithm teams to prioritize issues and ensure product improvements reflect real architectural and customer requirements.

  • Product Feedback & Roadmap: Gather insights from customer demonstrations and conversations, translating feedback into actionable recommendations for the product roadmap.

  • Knowledge Management: Develop reusable demonstration scripts, test cases, and shared documentation to improve internal knowledge sharing and product evaluation processes.

  • Key Account Management: Serve as the primary product-side contact for selected strategic customers, building strong relationships with their expansion, planning, and real estate teams.

  • Workflow Analysis: Understand customer processes from initial site assessment through permitting, identifying opportunities to automate, simplify, or connect existing workflows.

  • Technical Requirements Translation: Convert customer workflows and operational needs into concrete software requirements, rules, and parameters for development teams.

  • Implementation & Customer Success: Coordinate product rollouts, support customers through implementation and productive use, and maintain engagement after launch.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines formal architectural training with strong communication, analytical, and customer-facing skills. You should understand how buildings are designed and planned, be comfortable discussing technical concepts with software engineers, and have the ability to translate complex customer workflows into practical software requirements.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture.

  • Practical experience in architectural design, building planning, or permitting processes is highly desirable.

  • Fluency in English and German is required, with Korean language proficiency considered a strong advantage.

  • Confidence presenting products and communicating with international customers in multiple languages.

  • Basic understanding of artificial intelligence, algorithms, and programming concepts.

  • Ability to understand rule-based systems, interpret simple scripts or logical structures, and communicate effectively with technical development teams.

  • Familiarity with BIM software such as Revit or Archicad is advantageous.

  • Experience with parametric design tools such as Grasshopper is a plus.

  • Strong understanding of architectural planning workflows and customer decision-making processes.

  • Ability to analyze operational processes, identify inefficiencies, and translate findings into clear software requirements.

  • Previous experience in key account management, consulting, or customer-facing project management is highly valued.

  • A forward-deployed mindset, with the ability to work directly with customers, take ownership of their success, and act as a bridge between customer teams and engineers.

  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and a structured approach to testing and documentation.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers.

We're hiring Technical Support Specialists to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but build the systems that eliminate them, design how AI handles conversations, and turn customer patterns into product priorities.

You might’ve been the person on a team who builds the dashboards, automations, or workflows that make everyone else better from a Support, Implementation, CS Ops, or Analyst seat. Now you want to formalize that work as the role itself. As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't how many cases you closed; it's how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Use Good Judgment to Solve Cases. Own customer escalations with cases that genuinely require seasoned judgment, the ones AI can't safely close. Build and protect customer trust in moments that matter.
  • Build and own AI quality. Configure AI within Elation's stack (intents, knowledge sources, escalation rules), build lightweight external automations, and own the quality of AI outputs in your domain.
  • Synthesize and partner with Product/Eng. Produce formal weekly and monthly insights, participate in roadmap conversations with Product Development teams, and mentor Associates on their build and synthesis work.

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • Shipped 3–5 AI solutions
  • A monthly drumbeat of synthesized insights that Product and Engineering act on, with visible impact on customer experience or a measurable drop in case volume
  • Owns a measurable case-volume reduction in your domain by making cases not happen, not by closing them faster
  • You question default workflows instead of just executing them, and you ship more by removing work, not just doing more of it.
  • You build with AI to make yourself and the teammates around you faster — automating triage, drafting responses, prototyping internal tools, and turning one-off builds into reusable patterns Associates can run with.
  • Mentors Associate teammates on AI builds and pattern synthesis

Professional Qualifications

  • 0-4+ years of relevant experience inSupport, Implementation, CS Ops, embedded data analyst, or AI/automation tinkerer in any field.
  • A concrete portfolio of things you've built or shipped: prompt-engineered systems, dashboards, automations — with evidence of outcomes
  • Strong customer-facing communication and trust-building skills
  • Pattern recognition and synthesis muscle
  • AI-native default. Reaches for AI tools first, treats ambiguity as the work rather than a blocker, and wants to learn how to configure and supervise these systems — not just use them
  • A deep desire to drive results for our customers, with high ownership over the outcomes you own
  • Curiosity and natural problem-solving instincts
  • An instinct to raise the bar for the teammates around you — teaching others to build and synthesize, not just modeling it yourself

Show us your work

Along with your application, in a cover letter send us:

  1. 2–3 things you've built or shipped that changed a metric or outcome — what you made, who it was for, why did you need to do it, and what changed.
  2. A short story about a time your analysis or insight changed a decision someone else made.

title: Sales Engineer - Billing
description:
Elation is looking for an Sales Engineer - Billing to partner with our commercial selling teams as the billing and revenue cycle expert throughout the sales process. When prospects have detailed questions about claims workflows, denial management, or billing operations, you'll provide deep expertise, solve problems consultatively, and help close deals.

This is a pre-sales role focused on problem-solving and expertise, not just running demos. You'll conduct discovery with billing managers and practice administrators, translate complex workflows into clear solutions, and build the internal tools and processes that enable our team to sell with confidence.

This is also a builder role. You'll define what this function looks like by creating demo scripts, developing enablement programs, establishing office hours, and partnering with Product Marketing and Product Management to shape our approach. We're looking for someone entrepreneurial who thrives when building something new.

This role reports to the Director of Product Marketing with dotted-line reporting to the sales organization.

What You'll Do

Sales Support (60%)

  • Drive revenue by identifying and advancing qualified opportunities through expert billing consultation
  • Lead in-depth billing and revenue cycle conversations and demos with prospects when Account Executives (AEs) and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) need specialized expertise
  • Conduct discovery with billing managers, practice administrators, clinicians, and other stakeholders to understand their workflows, pain points, and financial goals
  • Translate billing challenges into clear solutions that prospects can act on
  • Partner with AEs to move deals forward by handling objections, validating ROI, and building credibility
  • Run product demos, though the primary focus is problem-solving rather than demo delivery
  • Help prospects understand our AI-powered billing capabilities and the future of revenue cycle automation

Build the Function (40%)

  • Create the processes, tools, and enablement resources this new role needs
  • Develop billing training and education programs for Account Executives and Customer Success Managers (CSMs)
  • Run internal billing office hours to answer questions and build team confidence
  • Create and maintain demo scripts, talk tracks, competitive positioning, and sales collateral
  • Serve as a billing expert for Product and Customer Marketing
  • Partner with Product to translate product capabilities into clear value stories that resonate with prospects
  • Share customer insights to inform product roadmap and messaging

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves:

Deep billing and revenue cycle expertise

This is non-negotiable. You can independently lead detailed conversations with experienced billing managers and practice administrators. You understand the end-to-end revenue cycle from a practice perspective: scheduling, charge capture, claims submission, payment posting, denial management, A/R follow-up, and patient collections. You also understand the payer side: claims processing, denial reasons, eligibility verification, ERA/EOB, timely filing, and payer rules. You can explain complex workflows in clear, accessible language.

2-5+ years in a solutions engineering or pre-sales role supporting sales of billing or revenue cycle software

You've done this job before. You've successfully helped sales teams close deals and drive revenue by providing specialized expertise, conducting discovery, and solving complex problems. You're valued for your subject matter knowledge and ability to translate technical workflows into business solutions that impact the bottom line.

Experience selling to medical practices

You've worked with primary care, specialty practices, or small independent physician groups. You understand practice operations and what matters to practice owners, administrators, and billing managers. You know how to sell to multiple stakeholders and build consensus across a buying committee.

Builder and entrepreneurial mindset

You're comfortable defining a new role. You don't need a playbook handed to you. You can create processes, build programs, and establish best practices in a fast-paced environment where things are still taking shape.

Quick learner and problem solver

You're adaptable and can quickly identify what's needed, then figure out how to deliver it. You're open to feedback and can adjust your approach based on what the team needs. You're a collaborator who supports AEs rather than overshadowing them.

AI enthusiast

You're excited about AI in healthcare and can position AI-powered billing as an opportunity (not a threat). You're comfortable learning new technology and explaining it to skeptical audiences.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Previous sales or account executive experience before transitioning to solutions engineering
  • Deep payer-side expertise beyond working knowledge (claims processing, denial management, payer rules, coding)
  • Experience with value-based care or alternative payment models
  • Deep understanding of the outpatient billing and revenue cycle solutions in the healthcare market landscape

Who You Are

  • Expert: You're confident leading detailed billing conversations without needing to defer to others
  • Consultative: You lead with questions and discovery, not feature lists or prescriptive answers
  • Builder: You're entrepreneurial and comfortable creating structure where none exists
  • Collaborative: You're a team player who supports Account Executives and makes them better at their jobs
  • Adaptable: You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities shift
  • Coachable: You're open to feedback and can adjust your approach based on what the team needs
  • Customer-focused: You genuinely care about helping practices succeed

Salary Range: $100,000 - $140,000k/yr + variable

We are seeking a people-focused HR Business Partner / Generalist to provide interim support while a member of our People team is out on leave. You’ll partner with the Chief People Officer and leaders across the business. The primary focus will be on employee relations, performance management, manager coaching, leave management, and ensuring consistent and thoughtful people practices. The ideal candidate brings strong business acumen, sound judgment, and deep knowledge of employment laws, particularly in California. This is a remote, part-time position (10 - 15 hours/week), anticipated to run from mid December through late April.

This is an opportunity for a seasoned HR professional who enjoys operating as a trusted advisor, building strong relationships, and helping a growing organization maintain a healthy, high-performing culture.

Responsibilities

Employee Relations & Performance Management

  • Provide hands-on guidance and support for complex employee relations matters, including investigations, conflict resolution, performance concerns, and employee escalations.
  • Coach managers through performance management situations, including feedback, positive performance plans, and appropriate documentation.
  • Partner with leaders to ensure consistent, fair, and legally sound approaches to employee matters.
  • Help foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and constructive feedback.

HR Operations & Compliance

  • Provide guidance on HR policies, practices, and employment-related matters.
  • Ensure HR practices align with applicable local, state, and federal employment laws and regulations, with particular emphasis on California employment law.
  • Partner with the People team on HR processes, documentation, and employee lifecycle matters as needed.

Manager Coaching & Development

  • Coach and develop managers on effective leadership practices, communication, performance management, and navigating a broad range of employee situations.
  • Build manager confidence and capability in handling people-related responsibilities.
  • Provide practical guidance to help leaders make thoughtful, informed, and consistent decisions.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience in roles such as HR Business Partner, HR Generalist, HR Manager, or similar.
  • 2+ years experience in managing all types of leaves (FLMA, ADA, STD, etc).
  • Strong understanding of employment laws and regulations at the local, state, and federal levels, including California employment law.
  • Significant hands-on experience managing employee relations matters and supporting performance management processes.
  • Proven ability to coach managers through sensitive employee situations.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect people strategies to broader business objectives.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters with professionalism.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with the ability to balance strategic priorities with hands-on execution.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the broader People team.

title: Dental Sales Engineer
description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Sales Engineer to continue building an industry-defining sales team. This role will work closely with Account Executives to tailor Dandy’s value to each practice we talk to through demonstrations of our product, answering technical questions, and providing in-depth knowledge of Dandy’s offering and the overall Dental industry. A successful Sales Engineer will be an expert on all things regarding analog and digital materials and processes in the laboratory and the operatory. They should also take the time to learn industry trends and Dandy’s innovations in order to be a resource for our customers and prospects. A Sales Engineer should be excited to work with customers, answer questions, and help them get to the "aha!" moment when they see Dandy’s value.

What You’ll Do

  • Become an expert on Dandy’s product offerings, workflows, and the dental industry

  • Be the go-to person for highly complex questions from prospective practices we are selling to

  • Work hand in hand with Enablement to help educate Dandy sellers on current and future offerings

  • Continue to challenge yourself and those around you to be an ambassador

  • Have an understanding of the Dandy sale process and supporting methodologies

  • Help Account Executives run demonstrations of the product for prospective practices

  • Work with Account Executives to deliver a tailored sales experience based on the pain & priorities of each practice.

  • Be a champion not only for Dandy, but also for the doctors that you interact with

  • Work cross-functionally with our internal teams to learn the newest Dandy offerings and how Dentists can transform their practice

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience as a Dental Technician (CDT preferred) in customer-facing roles within the dental lab space - sales experience preferred

  • Desire to learn all the nuances of Dandy’s digital workflows and how they relate to the analog workflows

  • Desire to teach our customers to think differently about their practice

  • Quick learner who can adapt to a high-paced rate of change

  • Ability to make complex laboratory concepts simple for customers to understand

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills

  • BA/BS degree is preferred

    • Dental Lab Degrees (Associate of Applied Science) strongly preferred

For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Background Investigator
description:
About the Company

Founded in 2018 by professors of Yale University and Columbia University, CertiK is a pioneer in blockchain security, utilizing best-in-class AI technology to secure and monitor blockchain protocols and smart contracts. CertiK’s mission is to secure the cyber world. Starting with blockchain, CertiK applies cutting-edge innovations from academia into enterprise, enabling mission-critical applications to be built with security and correctness. CertiK is one of the fastest growing and most trusted companies in blockchain security and has become a true market leader. Our clients include leading projects such as Aave, Polygon, Binance Smart Chain, Yearn, and Chiliz. Our investors include top VCs like Tiger Global, Coatue Management, Shunwei Capital and Hillhouse Capital as well as industry leaders like Coinbase Ventures and Binance.

About the Role

As a KYC Investigations Analyst, you will deliver CertiK's KYC badge product—the leading private identity verification service for Web3 project teams. You will conduct background interviews and investigations into project teams, diving deep to understand their transparency and risk levels. If the project team completes the screening, your work will culminate in issuing a CertiK KYC badge at an appropriate level that signifies set standards of verification.

About You

You are a skilled investigator with experience in conducting behavioral interviews while providing excellent customer service. You excel at finding critical information and analyzing it thoroughly. You communicate clearly and effectively, making it easy for others to understand your findings. You are self-motivated, detail-oriented, and can manage multiple tasks independently in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the delivery of CertiK’s KYC badge product
  • Conduct interviews with project team members to assess risks and identify discrepancies
  • Perform thorough investigations using open-source information with limited data
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients undergoing the KYC process
  • Communicate with teams about KYC badge status and requirements
  • Help customers submit identification documents and verify them through systems
  • Document your findings clearly to support each KYC badge decision
  • Evaluate project teams for quality and risk factors
  • Create content and thought leadership related to KYC and investigations in Web3

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in investigations, KYC or a related field
  • Proven experience conducting complex behavioral interviews
  • Fluent in English
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience performing OSINT investigations
  • Familiar with Web3 social media platforms, especially X/Twitter
  • Understanding of KYC regulations, AML/CFT laws, and compliance standards
  • Highly organized and self-driven, able to work independently
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Able to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively
  • Passionate about crypto and eager to learn about new projects

Compensation

Additional Information

Target annual salary for this role performed is $60,000 - $100,000. The exact compensation at which this job is filled will be determined by the skills and experience of qualified candidates.

CertiK accepts applications for this position on an ongoing basis.

CertiK is proud to offer medical, vision, and dental insurance, 401(k) plan with company matching, life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance, HSA (with high deductible plan), FSA, and other benefits to all full-time employees, along with flexible paid time off and holidays. CertiK also offers a variable commission program for business development sales roles.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

CertiK is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of age, race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, medical condition, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status or civil partnership/union status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth, genetic information, military and veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state or local law.

CertiK will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.

title: DTC Growth Strategist
description:
DTC GROWTH STRATEGIST

A DTC Growth Strategist at CTC drives profitable growth for clients by translating raw financial data into precise marketing maneuvers. You will guide clients and teammates with clear financial models, diagnostic reviews, and actionable recommendations, ensuring every marketing dollar is understood through the lens of profit.

When results deviate from plan, you’ll take ownership in diagnosing the issue, adjusting forecasts, and optimizing within the meta account in order to restore profitable growth. Above all, you are the financial steward of your accounts—trusted to bring clarity, accuracy, and solutions that align business goals with sustainable outcomes.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

YOU SET THE STANDARD

  • You seek to define “best in class” across both growth strategy and media buying.
  • You arrive prepared with forecasts, insights, and clear next steps.
  • You approach challenge and failure with curiosity and resilience.
  • Your word is trustworthy — people know that if you are involved, it will get done.
  • Your word is trustworthy; you do what you say you will

YOU ARE DRIVEN TO INCREASE VALUE

  • You exist to turn marketing strategies into financial outcomes.
  • You’re excited by the complexities of a business and love identifying growth solutions.
  • You thrive at translating platform execution into contribution margin and growth targets.
  • You clearly articulate complex concepts in ways that clients and teammates can understand.
  • You are in the habit of documenting, reporting, and forecasting your work.

YOU CREATE AN ENVIRONMENT OF EXCELLENCE

  • You inspire others with your expertise and strategic thinking.
  • You proactively share insights with your team and clients.
  • You embody humility (willing to do the work), ambition (vision for the future), and empathy (understanding what drives others).
  • You contribute learnings back into CTC’s systems and playbooks.
  • You balance strategy, execution, and communication to help others thrive.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

STRATEGY & FORECASTING

  • Build and maintain growth forecasts in Statlas.
  • Align forecasts with marketing calendars, launches, and contribution margin goals.
  • Translate forecasts into daily/weekly pacing to ensure spend and performance remain within targets.

MEDIA EXECUTION

  • Build, manage, and optimize campaigns across Meta, wile overseeing the management of Google, and YouTube (with expansion to TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat).
  • Lead creative diversification and media testing to profitably scale accounts.
  • Design and interpret incrementality tests (geo holdouts, conversion lift) and integrate results into iROAS modeling.
  • Troubleshoot campaigns quickly and pivot strategies when needed.

CLIENT COMMUNICATION & STORYTELLING

  • Serve as the primary growth partner for your accounts.
  • Communicate forecasts, results, and recommendations with clarity and confidence.
  • Lead weekly updates, monthly reviews, and quarterly planning sessions.

COLLABORATION & CONTRIBUTION

  • Contribute your learnings back into CTC’s shared processes and tools.
  • Act as a subject matter expert, helping advance CTC’s Growth Engineer framework.

Note: Pixel and feed health are managed by a separate floating ops resource. This role is focused on strategy, execution, and client outcomes.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Holding a book of business above agreed upon revenue targets
  • Retaining clients while guiding clients toward profitable growth
  • Consistently deliver forecasts within ±5% accuracy.
  • Grow Contribution Margin quarter over quarter
  • Grow media spend quarter over quarter at or above iROAS thresholds.
  • Run and apply incrementality tests that shape client investment decisions.
  • Demonstrate clear link between execution and contribution margin outcomes.
  • Earn client trust through clear communication, preparedness, and results.
  • Embody CTC’s values — Set the Standard, Driven to Increase Value, Create an Environment of Excellence.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • 4–6 years in eCommerce growth marketing with direct account ownership.
  • Proven ability to manage $100K+/month in paid media spend.
  • Hands-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube; familiarity with TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat.
  • Experience designing and interpreting incrementality tests.
  • Strong analytical skills with fluency in contribution margin, iROAS, and financial modeling.
  • High EQ and communication skills: trusted advisor, clear storyteller, resilient problem solver.
  • Curiosity and adaptability: thrive in ambiguity, learn fast, and share knowledge generously.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • $120K - $150K base salary, annually
    • This is prior to any benefits (see the “ABOUT US” Section for additional details
  • Bonus Structure | $30K-$50K bonus tiers

ABOUT US

At CTC, we are fixated on building the next generation of legendary brands and the people who will lead them.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing this mission, we organize all of our decisions — from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money — in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone. They're challenging.

In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

For those who resonate with the following values, CTC has proven itself to be a remarkable place to grow and thrive.

  1. We Set the Standard
  2. We Are Driven To Increase Value
  3. We Create an Environment of Excellence

We’ll come alongside you and care for you in your pursuits by offering full-time permanent CTC employees:

  • 401K | program with a 3% company match (post 90 days employment) to bring out the investor inside you
  • TIME OFF | When you’re at CTC, you’re firing on all cylinders. To make that possible, we offer a Flexible Time Off policy where you will coordinate with supervisor to take time away from the office for rest, travel, and variety of others things that are important to you!
  • MEDICAL | Full health, dental, and vision benefits that fit your lifestyle and goals
  • WELLNESS | A wellness reimbursement program that inspires 360 degrees of health: mentally, physically, and spiritually

Associate Account Executive

The Associate Account Executive plays a key role in driving CTC’s growth by managing a portfolio of eCommerce brands and uncovering opportunities to expand each partnership. This individual builds strong, trust-based relationships with clients, ensuring seamless delivery while identifying ways to increase value through new initiatives and strategic recommendations. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates with clarity and confidence, and brings a proactive, sales-minded approach to growing revenue and strengthening long-term client relationships.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

YOU SET THE STANDARD

The Associate Account Executive is responsible for driving revenue growth within their existing book of business by identifying, developing, and closing opportunities that expand the client partnership. This role combines strategic account management with proactive sales execution ensuring each client realizes the full potential of CTC’s services while the Associate Account Executive meets or exceeds defined monthly and quarterly upsell targets. Success in this role is measured by the ability to deepen client engagement, increase total account value, and consistently uncover new ways for CTC to deliver measurable business impact. The Associate Account Executive will:

  • Deliver on Revenue Accountability: Consistently meet or exceed upsell and renewal targets, contributing to both individual and company-wide revenue objectives.
  • Own the Upsell Pipeline: Maintain an active pipeline of expansion opportunities across the assigned client portfolio, accurately forecasting revenue and tracking progress toward monthly and quarterly sales goals.
  • Identify Growth Opportunities: Analyze account performance, client objectives, and market trends to pinpoint where CTC’s additional offerings (such as new channels, creative solutions, or strategic programs) can drive incremental ROI.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (Channel Leaders, TikTok Shops, Strategy, Creative, and Email) to design and deliver data-driven proposals that align client growth goals with CTC’s service capabilities.
  • Lead Strategic Conversations: Communicate new strategies, present performance insights, and position upsell opportunities as natural extensions of client success.
  • Proposal & Contract Ownership: Prepares accurate proposals, scopes, and contracts that align client needs with CTC’s services and internal guidelines.

YOU ARE DRIVEN TO INCREASE VALUE

The Associate Account Executive is responsible for developing deep, trust-based relationships with key client stakeholders, positioning CTC as an indispensable strategic partner in their growth journey. This role requires a balance of relational intelligence and business acumen, ensuring that every client interaction builds confidence, drives clarity, and reinforces CTC’s commitment to delivering measurable results. Success in this area means maintaining proactive communication, anticipating client needs, and collaborating cross-functionally to resolve challenges with speed and professionalism. The Associate Account Executive will:

  • Maintain a Client First Approach: Act as a trusted advisor and advocate, ensuring every upsell initiative strengthens the client’s overall results, satisfaction, and long-term partnership value.
  • Anticipate and Address Needs: Maintain a pulse on client goals, concerns, and market dynamics to identify risks early and provide proactive solutions before issues escalate.
  • Collaborate to Solve Challenges: Work closely with internal teams (including Strategy, Creative, Email, and Operations) to troubleshoot and resolve client challenges swiftly, ensuring alignment between client priorities and internal execution.
  • Integrate AI into Daily Workflow: Use AI tools to improve preparation, uncover account insights, and work more efficiently while demonstrating curiosity, accountability, and the ability to adapt quickly.

YOU CREATE AN ENVIRONMENT OF EXCELLENCE

The Associate Account Executive sets the tone for operational excellence across every client engagement, ensuring that communication, execution, and collaboration meet the highest professional standards. This role demands precision, accountability, and an unwavering commitment to quality. Creates an environment where both clients and internal teams can thrive. Success in this area is measured by the consistency, clarity, and care brought to every interaction, deliverable, and outcome. The Associate Account Executive will:

  • Demonstrate professionalism and attention to detail: Deliver high-quality work across every touchpoint, ensuring communication is clear, organized, and complete. Every interaction reflects CTC’s standard of excellence.
  • Take ownership and deliver on commitments: Manage priorities with accountability, meet deadlines reliably, and see projects through from concept to completion. Drives forward progress and resolves challenges with initiative and integrity.
  • Model excellence for others: Set an example through preparation, responsiveness, and follow-through, elevating the performance of peers and reinforcing a culture of trust and excellence across the team.
  • Pursue continuous improvement: Seek feedback, identify opportunities to enhance workflows or communication, and consistently refine approaches to make CTC’s client experience stronger, faster, and more impactful.

What Success Looks Like

Owning Expansion and Renewal Opportunities
You independently manage expansion and renewal opportunities from discovery through proposal, objection handling, negotiation, and close, consistently turning client needs into additional revenue for CTC.

Cross-Functional Service Fluency
You build strong relationships with internal departments, develop a clear understanding of their services and capabilities, and confidently connect client needs to the right CTC solutions.

Client Retention and Renewal Readiness
You maintain a clear understanding of client satisfaction, contract timing, and delivered value, working with account strategy leads to address risks and position accounts for successful renewals.

What You’ll Bring To The Table

  • Significant experience identifying, developing, and closing expansion opportunities within existing client relationships. This is a top requirement; if you haven’t owned sales conversations and closed revenue, this role isn’t for you
  • 2+ years of experience in account management, client success, or consultative sales with responsibility for revenue growth and retention
  • Ability to lead a structured sales process from opportunity identification and discovery through proposal, objection handling, negotiation, and close
  • Strong CRM discipline. You maintain accurate records, manage next steps, keep deal stages current, and provide clear visibility into the pipeline
  • Experience preparing proposals, scopes, and contracts that connect client needs with clear business value
  • Strong understanding of eCommerce, including customer acquisition, retention, merchandising, promotions, and the factors that drive profitable growth. Experience and knowledge of paid advertising platforms (Meta, Google, AppLovin, and more), email/sms marketing, Shopify, and TikTok commerce (TikTok Shop, TikTok ads)
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple accounts and sales opportunities with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to adapt to new services, sales processes, platform changes, and revenue goals

ORIENTATION

  • This role is primarily client-facing, responsible for developing strong relationships with key brand stakeholders and serving as their trusted partner. The Associate Account Executive will collaborate closely with internal service teams and drive the expansion conversations from start to finish.

title: Associate General Counsel
description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

As Associate General Counsel, Commercial & Customer Transactions, you’ll join our in-house legal team and serve as a senior, hands-on, commercially minded attorney supporting a fast-moving, billion-dollar SaaS business. You will help the Company move quickly through a high volume of customer MSA deviations and contract negotiations, customer escalations, procurement matters and ancillary agreements.

You’ll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Procurement, Product, Privacy, Compliance, Security and Finance to deliver practical, business-oriented solutions. This is an operator role for an attorney who can personally review, negotiate, resolve and close a significant volume of matters while exercising sound judgment about when to accept risk, when to negotiate and when to escalate.

We are an AI-forward legal team. You will use approved AI and automation tools every day to increase contracting velocity, resolve escalations faster, improve consistency and reduce repetitive legal effort while maintaining appropriate human judgment over material decisions, and you will help rethink how the work gets done.

Beyond your core work, this role offers meaningful exposure to product counseling, data privacy, compliance and corporate governance, giving you room to broaden your practice as the team and the business grow.

An intellectually curious, highly analytical, commercially minded and solutions-oriented attorney who thrives in a high-volume environment. You are fast without being careless, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and focused on closing matters rather than becoming another step in the process. You experiment with new AI tools before being asked, want to understand how the product actually works and enjoy stretching into adjacent areas of law. You communicate clearly with customers, vendors and internal stakeholders, and you understand that Legal’s role is to help the business operate intelligently and at speed.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Contracting & MSA Deviations

  • Review, negotiate and approve a high volume of customer-requested deviations from the Company’s standard MSA and related terms, applying playbook positions and exercising sound judgment on non-standard requests.
  • Draft, review and negotiate a high volume of customer commercial agreements, including SaaS agreements, master services agreements, order forms, amendments, statements of work, software licenses, services agreements, non-disclosure agreements and service-level agreements.
  • Quickly distinguish material legal and commercial risk from issues that do not justify slowing a transaction, and develop practical fallback positions and escalation paths.

Customer Escalations

  • Serve as a senior Legal escalation point for customer matters involving contractual rights and obligations, service issues, credits, disputes, termination rights, liability and other commercial concerns.
  • Use approved AI tools to rapidly assess the Company’s contractual position, contract history, business exposure, customer importance and practical resolution options, then provide clear recommendations that move matters toward resolution.

Ancillary & Data Agreements

  • Review and negotiate ancillary agreements and addenda, including Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), EU Data Act addenda, security and privacy addenda, confidentiality agreements, AI and data-use provisions and product-specific terms.

Procurement

  • Provide commercial legal support for selected procurement matters, including software, technology, services, vendor and licensing agreements.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product, Privacy, Compliance, Security and Engineering on contract commitments and product-adjacent issues involving privacy, data, security, artificial intelligence, software functionality and technology regulation.

AI-Enabled Legal Operations

  • Use approved AI tools to accelerate first-pass contract review, MSA deviation analysis, clause analysis, redlining, summarization, research, comparison and issue identification.
  • Build and improve AI-assisted workflows, playbooks, clause libraries, standard positions and self-service resources that increase Legal’s throughput and consistency.
  • Train Sales, Customer Success, Procurement and other business teams on contractual terms, negotiation parameters, escalation triggers and available legal self-help resources.
  • Support continuous improvement in contract management processes, legal operations and cross-functional workflows.

Additional Matters

  • Assist with additional day-to-day commercial, privacy, compliance and product-adjacent legal matters as business needs arise.

Required Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor from an ABA-accredited law school.
  • Active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • Approximately 7–12+ years of relevant legal experience, with meaningful in-house commercial experience strongly preferred.
  • Significant hands-on experience drafting and negotiating SaaS, software, technology and commercial customer agreements, including high-volume MSA negotiations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of simultaneous transactions, customer escalations and high-priority matters.
  • Experience negotiating privacy and data-related contractual terms, including DPAs and similar agreements; experience with BAAs and EU Data Act addenda is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working directly with sophisticated Sales, Customer Success, Product, Security, Procurement and Finance organizations.
  • Strong working knowledge of SaaS business models, software contracting, privacy, data security, intellectual property, indemnification, limitation of liability and related commercial risk issues.
  • Practical, daily experience using generative AI, AI contract review, contract lifecycle management automation or other LegalTech tools in legal work, and genuine curiosity about where these tools can take legal work next.
  • Strong analytical, negotiating, writing and communication skills, with the ability to provide concise, actionable business advice.
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach, coupled with the independence and judgment required to operate effectively at the Director level.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, infrastructure software, cloud or enterprise technology company strongly preferred.
  • Interest in growing into data privacy, compliance and product counseling.

title: Sales Setter - Vertrieb (w/m/d) mit Aufstieg zum Closer – Freelance | 100 % Remo
description:
Kennst du das?

Du bist ein guter Setter. Du greifst zum Hörer, ohne zu zögern. Aber deine Provision ist gedeckelt, das Angebot überzeugt dich selbst nicht ganz, und der Weg ins Closing ist seit Monaten „in Planung".

Du arbeitest mehr als die anderen und willst, dass sich das endlich auch im Einkommen zeigt? Bei uns ist das so.

NETSHAKE ist TÜV-zertifizierter Shopify Premier Partner – Top 1 % weltweit. 26 Jahre am Markt, über 1.700 Projekte. Zu unseren Kunden gehören Intersport und Junglück, die wir als Shopify-Partner von 3 auf 38 Millionen Euro Umsatz begleitet haben. Du verkaufst kein Versprechen. Du verkaufst Ergebnisse, die man nachprüfen kann.

Worum es geht

Du startest dort, wo sich Hunter beweisen. Du rufst E-Commerce-Entscheider an, holst sie ins Gespräch und setzt deine Termine selbst.

Der Deal ist einfach: Du zeigst, dass du am Telefon lieferst. Dann füllen unsere Opener deinen Kalender, und du konzentrierst dich voll auf Qualifizierungsgespräche mit hochwertigen Leads. Wer dort konstant performt, übernimmt eigene Closing-Gespräche.

Kein „irgendwann vielleicht". Der Weg zum Closer ist bei uns der Plan, nicht die Ausnahme.

Aufgaben

  • Du rufst AI-vorqualifizierte Leads an, Power Dialer, klarer Leitfaden

  • Du holst Entscheider ins Gespräch und weckst Interesse in den ersten Sekunden

  • Du qualifizierst: Bedarf, Potenzial, Entscheidungsbefugnis

  • Du setzt Termine, die stattfinden und sich schließen lassen

  • Du fasst nach, bis eine Entscheidung steht

  • Du führst deine Pipeline in Close CRM wie ein Unternehmer

  • Du übernimmst bei konstanter Performance eigene Strategie- und Closing-Gespräche

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im telefonischen Outbound-Vertrieb, zum Beispiel als Setter, Opener, im Telesales oder in der Terminierung

  • Du kennst deine Zahlen und legst sie auf den Tisch: Calls, gesetzte Termine, Show-up-Rate

  • Ein „Nein" spornt dich an, und beim ersten Widerstand legst du nicht auf

  • Du bleibst souverän, wenn ein Geschäftsführer dich testet

  • Du willst ins Closing und bist bereit, dir den Platz zu verdienen

  • Du nimmst Feedback an und setzt es am nächsten Tag um

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau

  • Ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, Headset

Benefits

  • Verdienst: Festes Monatshonorar ab 2.500 € plus Provision, ohne künstlichen Deckel. Wer mehr leistet, verdient mehr. Als Closer steigt dein Einkommenspotenzial deutlich.

  • Volle Kalender: Wer in der Akquise liefert, bekommt die Termine von unseren Openern geliefert.

  • Klarer Karrierepfad: Setter mit eigener Akquise → Setter mit vollem Kalender → Closer mit Umsatzverantwortung.

  • Training auf Closer-Niveau: Dein Vertriebsleiter ist der CEO selbst und trainiert dich täglich in der Verkaufspsychologie und Einwandbehandlung.

  • Vertrieb mit System: AI-vorqualifizierte Leads, Close CRM, Power Dialer.

  • Freelance, Vollzeit, 100 % remote: Weltweit. Das Office in Dubai steht dir offen.

  • Schneller Prozess: Vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Entscheidung vergehen ein bis zwei Wochen.

Dieser Job ist kein Nebenjob. Du arbeitest viel, telefonierst viel und wirst an deinen Zahlen gemessen. Dafür bekommst du ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung direkt bezahlt wird und der Weg zum Closer offen ist.

So läuft es ab

Kurzes Erstgespräch, Videocall, Schnuppertag am Telefon. Wir schauen auf Output, nicht auf Lebensläufe. Wir nehmen nicht jeden – und genau deshalb ist das Team stark.

Wenn du heute gut bist und außergewöhnlich werden willst: Bewirb dich mit deinen Zahlen.

NETSHAKE. Kein Limit im Kopf. Kein Limit im Einkommen. Komm ins Gewinnerteam.
